    class(*), intent(in) :: num
    select type (num)
    type is (integer(int64))
      res = num
    type is (integer(int32))
      res = int(num, int64)
    type is (integer(int16))
      res = int(num, int64)
    type is (integer(int8))
      res = int(num, int64)
    class default
      res = 0_8

    end select

  end

    class(modint), intent(inout) :: this
    class(*), intent(in) :: other

    class default
      val = to_int64(other)
      if (0_8 <= val .and. val < modu) then
        this%val = val
      else
        this%val = modulo(val, modu)
      end if
    end select
  end
  pure elemental type(modint) function add(this, other) result(res)
    class(modint), intent(in) :: this
    class(*), intent(in) :: other
    integer(int64) :: val
    select type (other)
    type is (modint)
      if (0_8 <= this%val + other%val .and. this%val + other%val < modu) then
        res%val = this%val + other%val
      else
        res%val = this%val + other%val - modu
      end if
    class default
      val = to_int64(other)
      if (0_8 <= this%val + val .and. this%val + val < modu) then
        res%val = this%val + val
      else
        res%val = modulo(this%val + val, modu)
      end if
    end select
  end
  pure elemental type(modint) function sub(this, other) result(res)
    class(modint), intent(in) :: this
    class(*), intent(in) :: other
    integer(int64) :: val
    select type (other)
    type is (modint)
      if (0_8 <= this%val - other%val .and. this%val - other%val < modu) then
        res%val = this%val - other%val
      else
        res%val = this%val - other%val + modu
      end if
    class default
      val = to_int64(other)
      if (0_8 <= this%val - val .and. this%val - val < modu) then
        res%val = this%val - val
      else
        res%val = modulo(this%val - val, modu)
      end if
    end select
  end
  pure elemental type(modint) function mul(this, other) result(res)
    class(modint), intent(in) :: this
    class(*), intent(in) :: other
    integer(int64) :: val
    select type (other)
    type is (modint)
      val = other%val
    class default
      val = to_int64(other)
    end select
    if (0_8 <= this%val * val .and. this%val * val < modu) then
      res%val = this%val * val
    else
      res%val = modulo(this%val * val, modu)
    end if
  end
  pure elemental type(modint) function div(this,other) result(res)
    class(modint), intent(in) :: this
    class(*), intent(in) :: other
    type(modint) :: tmp
    call asgn(tmp, other)
    call asgn(res, mul(this, inv(tmp)))
  end
  pure elemental integer(int64) function get(this) result(res)
    class(modint), intent(in) :: this
    res = this%val
  end
  pure elemental type(modint) function inv(this) result(res)
    class(modint), intent(in) :: this
    integer(int64) :: a, b, c, n
    integer(int64) :: x, y, z, m
    a = this%val
    b = modu
    c = 0_8
    n = 1_8
    do while (b /= 0_8)
      x = b
      y = mod(a,b)
      z = n-a/b*c
      m = c
      a = x
      b = y
      c = z
      n = m
    end do
    call asgn(res,n)
  end
  pure elemental type(modint) function pow(this, other) result(res)
    class(modint), intent(in) :: this
    class(*), intent(in) :: other
    integer(int64) :: n
    type(modint) :: i
    res%val = 1
    i%val = this%val
    n = to_int64(other)
    do while (n > 0_8)
      if (btest(n, 0)) call asgn(res, mul(res, i))
      call asgn(i, mul(i, i))
      n = rshift(n, 1)
    end do
  end
  pure elemental type(modint) function add_r(other, this) result(res)
    class(modint), intent(in) :: this
    class(*), intent(in) :: other
    call asgn(res, add(this, other))
  end
  pure elemental type(modint) function sub_r(other, this) result(res)
    class(modint), intent(in) :: this
    class(*), intent(in) :: other
    call asgn(res, sub(this, other))
  end
  pure elemental type(modint) function mul_r(other, this) result(res)
    class(modint), intent(in) :: this
    class(*), intent(in) :: other
    call asgn(res, mul(this, other))
  end
  pure elemental type(modint) function div_r(other, this) result(res)
    class(modint), intent(in) :: this
    class(*), intent(in) :: other
    call asgn(res, div(this, other))
  end
  pure type(modint) function dot_prod(x, y) result(res)
    type(modint), intent(in) :: x(:), y(:)
    integer :: i
    if (size(x, 1) /= size(y, 1)) i = to_int64('')
    do i = 1, size(x,1)
      call asgn(res, add(res, mul(x(i), y(i))))
    end do
  end
  pure function matmul1(x, y) result(res)
    type(modint), intent(in) :: x(:, :), y(:)
    type(modint) :: res(size(x, 1))
    integer :: i
    do i = 1, size(x, 1)
      call asgn(res(i), dot_prod(x(i, :), y))
    end do
  end
  pure function matmul2(x, y) result(res)
    type(modint), intent(in) :: x(:), y(:, :)
    type(modint) :: res(size(y, 2))
    integer :: i
    do i = 1, size(y, 2)
      call asgn(res(i), dot_prod(x, y(:, i)))
    end do
  end
  pure function matmul3(x, y) result(res)
    type(modint), intent(in) :: x(:, :), y(:, :)
    type(modint) :: res(size(x, 1), size(y, 2))
    integer :: i
    do i = 1, size(x, 1)
      call asgn(res(i, :), matmul2(x(i, :), y))
    end do
  end
end module module_modint
module modulo_utils
  use module_modint
  implicit none
  type(modint), allocatable :: f(:), invf(:)
contains
  subroutine init(n)
    integer, intent(in) :: n
    integer :: i
    if (allocated(f)) deallocate(f)
    if (allocated(invf)) deallocate(invf)
    allocate(f(0:n), invf(0:n))
    f(0) = 1
    do i = 1, n
      f(i) = f(i - 1) * i
    end do
    invf(n) = f(n)%inv()
    do i = n, 1, -1
      invf(i - 1) = invf(i) * i
    end do
  end
  pure elemental type(modint) function perm(n, k) result(res)
    integer, intent(in) :: n, k
    if (k > n .or. n < 0 .or. k < 0) return
    res = f(n) * invf(n - k)
  end
  pure elemental type(modint) function comb(n, k) result(res)
    integer, intent(in) :: n, k
    res = perm(n, k) * invf(k)
  end
  pure elemental type(modint) function homo(n, k) result(res)
    integer, intent(in) :: n, k
    res = 1
    if (n == 0 .and. k == 0) return
    res = comb(n + k - 1, k)
  end
end module modulo_utils
program many_many_paths
  use module_modint
  use modulo_utils
  implicit none
  integer :: r1, c1, r2, c2
  type(modint) :: x
  read(*,*) r1, c1, r2, c2
  r2 = r2 + 1
  c2 = c2 + 1
  call init(r2 + c2)
  x = comb(r2 + c2, r2) - comb(r2 + c1, r2) - comb(r1 + c2, r1) + comb(r1 + c1, r1)
  write(*,'(i0)') x%get()
end program many_many_paths

{-# INLINE_FUSED zipTailWithM_stream #-}
zipTailWithM_stream :: Monad m =>
  (a -> a -> m b) -> VFSM.Stream m a -> VFSM.Stream m b
zipTailWithM_stream f (VFSM.Stream step s) = VFSM.Stream step2 (Nothing, s)
  where
    {-# INLINE_INNER step2 #-}
    step2 (Nothing, s0) = (<$> step s0) $ \res -> case res of
      VFSM.Yield a1 s1 -> VFSM.Skip (Just a1, s1)
      VFSM.Skip     s1 -> VFSM.Skip (Nothing, s1)
      VFSM.Done        -> VFSM.Done
    step2 (Just a0, s0) = step s0 >>= \res -> case res of
      VFSM.Yield a1 s1 -> (`VFSM.Yield` (Just a1, s1)) <$> f a0 a1
      VFSM.Skip     s1 -> return $ VFSM.Skip (Just a0, s1)
      VFSM.Done        -> return $ VFSM.Done

{-# INLINE zipTailWith_stream #-}
zipTailWith_stream :: Monad m =>
  (a -> a -> b) -> VFSM.Stream m a -> VFSM.Stream m b
zipTailWith_stream f = zipTailWithM_stream (\a0 a1 -> return (f a0 a1))

{-# INLINE zipTail_stream #-}
zipTail_stream :: Monad m => VFSM.Stream m a -> VFSM.Stream m (a,a)
zipTail_stream = zipTailWith_stream (,)

{-# INLINE_FUSED zipTailWithM_mbundle #-}
zipTailWithM_mbundle :: Monad m =>
  (a -> a -> m b) -> VFBM.Bundle m v a -> VFBM.Bundle m v b
zipTailWithM_mbundle f VFBM.Bundle{VFBM.sElems = s, VFBM.sSize = n}
  = VFBM.fromStream (zipTailWithM_stream f s) (VFBS.clampedSubtract n 1)

{-# INLINE zipTailWith_mbundle #-}
zipTailWith_mbundle :: Monad m =>
  (a -> a -> b) -> VFBM.Bundle m v a -> VFBM.Bundle m v b
zipTailWith_mbundle f = zipTailWithM_mbundle (\a0 a1 -> return $ f a0 a1)

{-# INLINE zipTail_mbundle #-}
zipTail_mbundle :: Monad m => VFBM.Bundle m v a -> VFBM.Bundle m v (a,a)
zipTail_mbundle = zipTailWith_mbundle (,)

{-# INLINE zipTailWith_bundle #-}
zipTailWith_bundle :: (a -> a -> b) -> VFB.Bundle v a -> VFB.Bundle v b

factMax :: Int
factMax = 2000005

factorials :: VU.Vector RemF
factorials
  = VU.scanl' (*) 1 $ VU.tail $ VU.generate (factMax+1) (remF . fromIntegral)

factorial :: Int -> RemF
factorial = (factorials VU.!)

factoInvs :: VU.Vector RemF
factoInvs
  = VU.reverse
  $ VU.scanl' (*) (recip $ VU.last factorials)
  $ VU.enumFromStepN (fromIntegral factMax) (fromIntegral (-1)) factMax 

invFacto :: Int -> RemF
invFacto = (factoInvs VU.!)

perm :: Int -> Int -> RemF
perm !n !k
  | k == 0 = 1
  | k < 0 || k > n || n < 0 = 0
  | otherwise = factorial n * invFacto (n-k)

comb :: Int -> Int -> RemF
comb !n !k
  | k == 0 = 1
  | k < 0 || k > n || n < 0 = 0
  | otherwise = factorial n * invFacto k * invFacto (n-k)



data FixedModulus

instance HasWord32 FixedModulus where
  {-# INLINE CONLIKE word32Val #-}
  word32Val = const 1000000007 -- 10^9 + 7

type RemF = Rem FixedModulus

pxyF :: Proxy FixedModulus
pxyF = Proxy
remF :: Word32 -> RemF
{-# INLINE CONLIKE remF #-}
remF = Rem

newtype Magic r = Magic (forall (m :: *). HasWord32 m => Proxy m -> r)

{-# INLINE reifyWord32 #-}
reifyWord32 :: forall a. Word32 ->
  (forall (m :: *). HasWord32 m => Proxy m -> a) -> a
reifyWord32 v f = unsafeCoerce (Magic f :: Magic a) (const v) Proxy

newtype Rem m = Rem {unRem :: Word32} deriving (Eq)

withTypeArgOf :: c a -> d a -> c a
{-# INLINE CONLIKE withTypeArgOf #-}
withTypeArgOf = const

proxyFor :: c a -> Proxy a
{-# INLINE CONLIKE proxyFor #-}
proxyFor = const Proxy

{-# INLINE withProxy #-}
withProxy f = f Proxy

remP :: Proxy m -> Word32 -> Rem m
{-# INLINE CONLIKE remP #-}
remP = const Rem

{-# INLINE modulus32 #-}
modulus32 :: HasWord32 m => Rem m -> Word32
modulus32 x = word32Val $ proxyFor x

class HasWord32 m where
  word32Val :: Proxy m -> Word32

instance Show (Rem m) where
  {-# INLINE showsPrec #-}
  showsPrec = coerce `asTypeOf` (\f p (Rem v) -> f p v) $ showsPrec

negRem :: HasWord32 m => Rem m -> Rem m
{-# INLINE negRem #-}
negRem x0@(Rem x)
  | x == 0 = Rem 0
  | otherwise = Rem $ modulus32 x0 - x

addRem, subRem, multRem
  :: HasWord32 m => Rem m -> Rem m -> Rem m
{-# INLINE subRem #-}
subRem x0@(Rem x) (Rem y) = Rem $ x-y + if x < y then modulus32 x0 else 0
{-# INLINE addRem #-}
addRem x0@(Rem x) (Rem y) = Rem $ x-negy + if x < negy then m else 0
  where m = modulus32 x0; negy = m-y
{-# INLINE multRem #-}
multRem x0@(Rem x) (Rem y)
  = Rem $ toW32 $ (toW64 x * toW64 y) `rem` toW64 (modulus32 x0)

{-# INLINE fromIntegerRem #-}
fromIntegerRem :: (HasWord32 m) => Integer -> Rem m
fromIntegerRem x = withProxy $ Rem . fromInteger . mod x . toInteger . word32Val

{-# INLINE signumRem #-}
signumRem :: (HasWord32 m) => Rem m -> Rem m
signumRem = (\case True -> Rem 0; False -> Rem 1) . (== Rem 0)

instance HasWord32 m => Num (Rem m) where
  {-# INLINE negate #-}
  negate = negRem
  {-# INLINE (-) #-}
  (-) = subRem
  {-# INLINE (+) #-}
  (+) = addRem
  {-# INLINE (*) #-}
  (*) = multRem
  {-# INLINE fromInteger #-}
  fromInteger = fromIntegerRem
  {-# INLINE abs #-}
  abs = id
  {-# INLINE signum #-}
  signum = signumRem

recipRem :: HasWord32 m => Rem m -> Rem m
{-# INLINE recipRem #-}
recipRem = \x -> x ^ (modulus32 x - 2)

-- works only for primes
instance HasWord32 m => Fractional (Rem m) where
  {-# INLINE recip #-}
  recip = recipRem
  fromRational q = fromInteger (numerator q) / fromInteger (denominator q)

IL(showTupAsBuilderWith)
  :: (a -> BSB.Builder) -> (b -> BSB.Builder) -> (a,b) -> BSB.Builder

  = \(a,b) -> (showA a <>) $ BSB.char7 ' ' <> showB b

  (c -> BSB.Builder) -> (a,b,c) -> BSB.Builder
showTup3AsBuilderWith showA showB showC
  = \(a,b,c) -> (showA a <>) $ (BSB.char7 ' ' <>) $ (showB b <>)

  => (a,b,c) -> BSB.Builder

  = \(a,b,c,d) -> (showA a <>) $ (BSB.char7 ' ' <>)

  => BS.ByteString -- ^ prefix
  -> BS.ByteString -- ^ separator
  -> BS.ByteString -- ^ postfix
  -> (a -> BSB.Builder) -- ^ show function
  -> v a -> BSB.Builder
vecToBuilder !prefix !separator !postfix
  = vecToBuilder_ (BSB.byteString prefix)
                  (BSB.byteString separator)
                  (BSB.byteString postfix)


IL(vecToBuilder_) :: (VG.Vector v a)
  => BSB.Builder -- ^ prefix
  -> BSB.Builder -- ^ separator
  -> BSB.Builder -- ^ postfix
  -> (a -> BSB.Builder) -- ^ show function
  -> v a -> BSB.Builder
vecToBuilder_ !prefix !separator !postfix showFct = \vec -> prefix <>
  VG.foldr
  (\ a rest !prefx -> prefx <> (showFct a <> rest separator))
  (const postfix) vec mempty

  (a -> b -> (c,a)) -> a -> VFSM.Stream m b -> VFSM.Stream m c
{-# INLINE_FUSED streamMapFoldl #-}
streamMapFoldl f a (VFSM.Stream step s) = VFSM.Stream step1 (a,s)
  where
    {-# INLINE_INNER step1 #-}
    step1 (a0,s0) =  (<$> step s0) $ \r -> case r of
      VFSM.Yield b s1 -> case f a0 b of (c,a1) -> VFSM.Yield c (a1,s1)
      VFSM.Skip    s1 -> VFSM.Skip (a0,s1)
      VFSM.Done       -> VFSM.Done

main :: IO ()
main = do
  [r1,c1,r2,c2] <- map readInt . words <$> getLine
  let requiredCoeffs = (`VU.map` VU.enumFromN (r1+c1) (r2+c2-r1-c1+1))
        $ \ !n -> (n,max r1 $ n-c2, min r2 $ n-c1)
      ress = (\f -> VU.scanl' f (comb (r1+c1) r1) $ vZipTail requiredCoeffs)
             $ \ !prevSum ((!n,!k0n,!k1n),(!np1,!k0np1,!k1np1)) ->
                 prevSum + prevSum
                 + (if k1n < k1np1
                    then comb n k1np1
                    else negate $ comb n k1np1)
                 + (if k0n < k0np1
                     then negate $ comb n k0n
                     else comb n (k0n-1))
  print $ VU.sum ress
  return ()

zipTailWithM_stream :: Monad m =>
  (a -> a -> m b) -> VFSM.Stream m a -> VFSM.Stream m b
zipTailWithM_stream f (VFSM.Stream step s) = VFSM.Stream step2 (Nothing, s)
  where
    {-# INLINE_INNER step2 #-}
    step2 (Nothing, s0) = (<$> step s0) $ \res -> case res of
      VFSM.Yield a1 s1 -> VFSM.Skip (Just a1, s1)
      VFSM.Skip     s1 -> VFSM.Skip (Nothing, s1)
      VFSM.Done        -> VFSM.Done
    step2 (Just a0, s0) = step s0 >>= \res -> case res of
      VFSM.Yield a1 s1 -> (`VFSM.Yield` (Just a1, s1)) <$> f a0 a1
      VFSM.Skip     s1 -> return $ VFSM.Skip (Just a0, s1)
      VFSM.Done        -> return $ VFSM.Done

{-# INLINE zipTailWith_stream #-}
zipTailWith_stream :: Monad m =>
  (a -> a -> b) -> VFSM.Stream m a -> VFSM.Stream m b
zipTailWith_stream f = zipTailWithM_stream (\a0 a1 -> return (f a0 a1))

{-# INLINE zipTail_stream #-}
zipTail_stream :: Monad m => VFSM.Stream m a -> VFSM.Stream m (a,a)
zipTail_stream = zipTailWith_stream (,)

{-# INLINE_FUSED zipTailWithM_mbundle #-}
zipTailWithM_mbundle :: Monad m =>
  (a -> a -> m b) -> VFBM.Bundle m v a -> VFBM.Bundle m v b
zipTailWithM_mbundle f VFBM.Bundle{VFBM.sElems = s, VFBM.sSize = n}
  = VFBM.fromStream (zipTailWithM_stream f s) (VFBS.clampedSubtract n 1)

{-# INLINE zipTailWith_mbundle #-}
zipTailWith_mbundle :: Monad m =>
  (a -> a -> b) -> VFBM.Bundle m v a -> VFBM.Bundle m v b
zipTailWith_mbundle f = zipTailWithM_mbundle (\a0 a1 -> return $ f a0 a1)

{-# INLINE zipTail_mbundle #-}
zipTail_mbundle :: Monad m => VFBM.Bundle m v a -> VFBM.Bundle m v (a,a)
zipTail_mbundle = zipTailWith_mbundle (,)

{-# INLINE zipTailWith_bundle #-}
zipTailWith_bundle :: (a -> a -> b) -> VFB.Bundle v a -> VFB.Bundle v b
zipTailWith_bundle = zipTailWith_mbundle

{-# INLINE zipTail_bundle #-}
zipTail_bundle :: VFB.Bundle v a -> VFB.Bundle v (a,a)

vZipTailWith :: (VG.Vector v a, VG.Vector v b) => (a -> a -> b) -> v a -> v b

factMax :: Int
factMax = 2000005

factorials :: VU.Vector RemF
factorials
  = VU.scanl' (*) 1 $ VU.tail $ VU.generate (factMax+1) (remF . fromIntegral)

factorial :: Int -> RemF
factorial = (factorials VU.!)

factoInvs :: VU.Vector RemF
factoInvs
  = VU.reverse
  $ VU.scanl' (*) (recip $ VU.last factorials)
  $ VU.enumFromStepN (fromIntegral factMax) (fromIntegral (-1)) factMax 

invFacto :: Int -> RemF
invFacto = (factoInvs VU.!)

perm :: Int -> Int -> RemF
perm !n !k
  | k == 0 = 1
  | k < 0 || k > n || n < 0 = 0
  | otherwise = factorial n * invFacto (n-k)

comb :: Int -> Int -> RemF
comb !n !k
  | k == 0 = 1
  | k < 0 || k > n || n < 0 = 0
  | otherwise = factorial n * invFacto k * invFacto (n-k)



data FixedModulus

instance HasWord32 FixedModulus where
  {-# INLINE CONLIKE word32Val #-}
  word32Val = const 1000000007 -- 10^9 + 7

type RemF = Rem FixedModulus

pxyF :: Proxy FixedModulus
pxyF = Proxy
remF :: Word32 -> RemF
{-# INLINE CONLIKE remF #-}
remF = Rem

newtype Magic r = Magic (forall (m :: *). HasWord32 m => Proxy m -> r)

{-# INLINE reifyWord32 #-}
reifyWord32 :: forall a. Word32 ->
  (forall (m :: *). HasWord32 m => Proxy m -> a) -> a
reifyWord32 v f = unsafeCoerce (Magic f :: Magic a) (const v) Proxy

newtype Rem m = Rem {unRem :: Word32} deriving (Eq)

withTypeArgOf :: c a -> d a -> c a
{-# INLINE CONLIKE withTypeArgOf #-}
withTypeArgOf = const

proxyFor :: c a -> Proxy a
{-# INLINE CONLIKE proxyFor #-}
proxyFor = const Proxy

withProxy :: (Proxy m -> c m) -> c m
{-# INLINE withProxy #-}
withProxy f = f Proxy

remP :: Proxy m -> Word32 -> Rem m
{-# INLINE CONLIKE remP #-}
remP = const Rem

{-# INLINE modulus32 #-}
modulus32 :: HasWord32 m => Rem m -> Word32
modulus32 x = word32Val $ proxyFor x

class HasWord32 m where
  word32Val :: Proxy m -> Word32

instance Show (Rem m) where
  {-# INLINE showsPrec #-}
  showsPrec = coerce `asTypeOf` (\f p (Rem v) -> f p v) $ showsPrec

negRem :: HasWord32 m => Rem m -> Rem m
{-# INLINE negRem #-}
negRem x0@(Rem x)
  | x == 0 = Rem 0
  | otherwise = Rem $ modulus32 x0 - x

addRem, subRem, multRem
  :: HasWord32 m => Rem m -> Rem m -> Rem m
{-# INLINE subRem #-}
subRem x0@(Rem x) (Rem y) = Rem $ x-y + if x < y then modulus32 x0 else 0
{-# INLINE addRem #-}
addRem x0@(Rem x) (Rem y) = Rem $ x-negy + if x < negy then m else 0
  where m = modulus32 x0; negy = m-y
{-# INLINE multRem #-}
multRem x0@(Rem x) (Rem y)
  = Rem $ toW32 $ (toW64 x * toW64 y) `rem` toW64 (modulus32 x0)

{-# INLINE fromIntegerRem #-}
fromIntegerRem :: (HasWord32 m) => Integer -> Rem m
fromIntegerRem x = withProxy $ Rem . fromInteger . mod x . toInteger . word32Val

{-# INLINE signumRem #-}
signumRem :: (HasWord32 m) => Rem m -> Rem m
signumRem = (\case True -> Rem 0; False -> Rem 1) . (== Rem 0)

instance HasWord32 m => Num (Rem m) where
  {-# INLINE negate #-}
  negate = negRem
  {-# INLINE (-) #-}
  (-) = subRem
  {-# INLINE (+) #-}
  (+) = addRem
  {-# INLINE (*) #-}
  (*) = multRem
  {-# INLINE fromInteger #-}
  fromInteger = fromIntegerRem
  {-# INLINE abs #-}
  abs = id
  {-# INLINE signum #-}
  signum = signumRem

recipRem :: HasWord32 m => Rem m -> Rem m
{-# INLINE recipRem #-}
recipRem = \x -> x ^ (modulus32 x - 2)

-- works only for primes
instance HasWord32 m => Fractional (Rem m) where
  {-# INLINE recip #-}
  recip = recipRem
  fromRational q = fromInteger (numerator q) / fromInteger (denominator q)

IL(showTupAsBuilderWith)
  :: (a -> BSB.Builder) -> (b -> BSB.Builder) -> (a,b) -> BSB.Builder

  = \(a,b) -> (showA a <>) $ BSB.char7 ' ' <> showB b

  => (a,b) -> BSB.Builder

  (c -> BSB.Builder) -> (a,b,c) -> BSB.Builder
showTup3AsBuilderWith showA showB showC
  = \(a,b,c) -> (showA a <>) $ (BSB.char7 ' ' <>) $ (showB b <>)
                $ (BSB.char7 ' ' <>) $ showC c
IL(showTup3AsBuilder) :: (ShowAsBuilder a, ShowAsBuilder b, ShowAsBuilder c)
  => (a,b,c) -> BSB.Builder

  (c -> BSB.Builder) -> (d -> BSB.Builder) -> (a,b,c,d) -> BSB.Builder
showTup4AsBuilderWith showA showB showC showD
  = \(a,b,c,d) -> (showA a <>) $ (BSB.char7 ' ' <>)
                  $ showTup3AsBuilderWith showB showC showD (b,c,d)

  (ShowAsBuilder a, ShowAsBuilder b, ShowAsBuilder c, ShowAsBuilder d) =>

  -> BS.ByteString -- ^ postfix
  -> (a -> BSB.Builder) -- ^ show function
  -> v a -> BSB.Builder

  = vecToBuilder_ (BSB.byteString prefix)
                  (BSB.byteString separator)
                  (BSB.byteString postfix)

  => BSB.Builder -- ^ prefix
  -> BSB.Builder -- ^ separator
  -> BSB.Builder -- ^ postfix
  -> (a -> BSB.Builder) -- ^ show function
  -> v a -> BSB.Builder
vecToBuilder_ !prefix !separator !postfix showFct = \vec -> prefix <>
  VG.foldr
  (\ a rest !prefx -> prefx <> (showFct a <> rest separator))
  (const postfix) vec mempty

  (a -> b -> (c,a)) -> a -> VFSM.Stream m b -> VFSM.Stream m c
{-# INLINE_FUSED streamMapFoldl #-}
streamMapFoldl f a (VFSM.Stream step s) = VFSM.Stream step1 (a,s)
  where
    {-# INLINE_INNER step1 #-}
    step1 (a0,s0) =  (<$> step s0) $ \r -> case r of
      VFSM.Yield b s1 -> case f a0 b of (c,a1) -> VFSM.Yield c (a1,s1)
      VFSM.Skip    s1 -> VFSM.Skip (a0,s1)
      VFSM.Done       -> VFSM.Done

  let

f :: Int -> Int -> Int
f r c = modComb (r + c) r

modInv :: Int -> Int
modInv = (invs VU.!)
  where
    invs :: VU.Vector Int
    invs = VU.constructN (2 * 10 ^ 6 + 1) rec
      where
        rec v = case VU.length v of
          0 -> 0
          1 -> 1
          l -> let (q, r) = modulus `divMod` l in (modulus - (v VU.! r) * q) `mod` modulus

modFact :: Int -> Int
modFact = (facts VU.!)
  where
    facts :: VU.Vector Int
    facts = VU.unfoldrN (2 * 10 ^ 6 + 1) next (0, 0)
      where
        next (0, _) = Just (1, (1, 1))
        next (i, x) = let x' = (x * i) `mod` modulus in Just (x', (succ i, x'))

modFactInv :: Int -> Int
modFactInv = (factInvs VU.!)
  where
    factInvs :: VU.Vector Int
    factInvs = VU.unfoldrN (2 * 10 ^ 6 + 1) next (0, 0)
      where
        next (0, _) = Just (1, (1, 1))
        next (i, x) = let x' = (x * modInv i) `mod` modulus in Just (x', (succ i, x'))

modComb :: Int -> Int -> Int
modComb n k | n < 0 || k < 0 || n < k = 0
            | otherwise               = ((modFact n * modInv (modFact (n - k)) `mod` modulus) * modInv (modFact k)) `mod` modulus

modulus :: Int
modulus = 10 ^ 9 + 7

unsafeTextToInt :: T.Text -> Int
unsafeTextToInt s = case T.signed T.decimal s of
  Right (n, _) -> n

solve :: Int -> Int -> Int -> Int -> IntMod
solve r1 c1 r2 c2
    = cum r2 c2
    - cum r2 (c1 - 1)
    - cum (r1 - 1) c2
    + cum (r1 - 1) (c1 - 1)
  where
    cum r c
        = U.foldl' (+) 1
        $ U.generate (r + 2) $ \i -> comb (i + c) c

{-# INLINE_FUSED zipTailWithM_stream #-}
zipTailWithM_stream :: Monad m =>
  (a -> a -> m b) -> VFSM.Stream m a -> VFSM.Stream m b
zipTailWithM_stream f (VFSM.Stream step s) = VFSM.Stream step2 (Nothing, s)
  where
    {-# INLINE_INNER step2 #-}
    step2 (Nothing, s0) = (<$> step s0) $ \res -> case res of
      VFSM.Yield a1 s1 -> VFSM.Skip (Just a1, s1)
      VFSM.Skip     s1 -> VFSM.Skip (Nothing, s1)
      VFSM.Done        -> VFSM.Done
    step2 (Just a0, s0) = step s0 >>= \res -> case res of
      VFSM.Yield a1 s1 -> (`VFSM.Yield` (Just a1, s1)) <$> f a0 a1
      VFSM.Skip     s1 -> return $ VFSM.Skip (Just a0, s1)
      VFSM.Done        -> return $ VFSM.Done

{-# INLINE zipTailWith_stream #-}
zipTailWith_stream :: Monad m =>
  (a -> a -> b) -> VFSM.Stream m a -> VFSM.Stream m b
zipTailWith_stream f = zipTailWithM_stream (\a0 a1 -> return (f a0 a1))

{-# INLINE zipTail_stream #-}
zipTail_stream :: Monad m => VFSM.Stream m a -> VFSM.Stream m (a,a)
zipTail_stream = zipTailWith_stream (,)

{-# INLINE_FUSED zipTailWithM_mbundle #-}
zipTailWithM_mbundle :: Monad m =>
  (a -> a -> m b) -> VFBM.Bundle m v a -> VFBM.Bundle m v b
zipTailWithM_mbundle f VFBM.Bundle{VFBM.sElems = s, VFBM.sSize = n}
  = VFBM.fromStream (zipTailWithM_stream f s) (VFBS.clampedSubtract n 1)

{-# INLINE zipTailWith_mbundle #-}
zipTailWith_mbundle :: Monad m =>
  (a -> a -> b) -> VFBM.Bundle m v a -> VFBM.Bundle m v b
zipTailWith_mbundle f = zipTailWithM_mbundle (\a0 a1 -> return $ f a0 a1)

{-# INLINE zipTail_mbundle #-}
zipTail_mbundle :: Monad m => VFBM.Bundle m v a -> VFBM.Bundle m v (a,a)
zipTail_mbundle = zipTailWith_mbundle (,)

factMax :: Int
factMax = 2000005

factorials :: VU.Vector RemF
factorials
  = VU.scanl' (*) 1 $ VU.tail $ VU.generate (factMax+1) (remF . fromIntegral)

factorial :: Int -> RemF
factorial = (factorials VU.!)

factoInvs :: VU.Vector RemF
factoInvs
  = VU.reverse
  $ VU.scanl' (*) (recip $ VU.last factorials)
  $ VU.enumFromStepN (fromIntegral factMax) (fromIntegral (-1)) factMax 

invFacto :: Int -> RemF
invFacto = (factoInvs VU.!)

perm :: Int -> Int -> RemF
perm !n !k
  | k == 0 = 1
  | k < 0 || k > n || n < 0 = 0
  | otherwise = factorial n * invFacto (n-k)

comb :: Int -> Int -> RemF
comb !n !k
  | k == 0 = 1
  | k < 0 || k > n || n < 0 = 0
  | otherwise = factorial n * invFacto k * invFacto (n-k)

addRem, subRem, multRem
  :: HasWord32 m => Rem m -> Rem m -> Rem m
{-# INLINE subRem #-}
subRem x0@(Rem x) (Rem y) = Rem $ x-y + if x < y then modulus32 x0 else 0
{-# INLINE addRem #-}
addRem x0@(Rem x) (Rem y) = Rem $ x-negy + if x < negy then m else 0
  where m = modulus32 x0; negy = m-y
{-# INLINE multRem #-}
multRem x0@(Rem x) (Rem y)
  = Rem $ toW32 $ (toW64 x * toW64 y) `rem` toW64 (modulus32 x0)

fromIntegerRem x = withProxy $ Rem . fromInteger . mod x . toInteger . word32Val

signumRem = (\case True -> Rem 0; False -> Rem 1) . (== Rem 0)

  :: (a -> BSB.Builder) -> (b -> BSB.Builder) -> (a,b) -> BSB.Builder

  (c -> BSB.Builder) -> (a,b,c) -> BSB.Builder

  = \(a,b,c) -> (showA a <>) $ (BSB.char7 ' ' <>) $ (showB b <>)

  = \(a,b,c,d) -> (showA a <>) $ (BSB.char7 ' ' <>)
                  $ showTup3AsBuilderWith showB showC showD (b,c,d)

IL(vecToBuilder) :: (VG.Vector v a)
  => BS.ByteString -- ^ prefix
  -> BS.ByteString -- ^ separator
  -> BS.ByteString -- ^ postfix
  -> (a -> BSB.Builder) -- ^ show function
  -> v a -> BSB.Builder
vecToBuilder !prefix !separator !postfix
  = vecToBuilder_ (BSB.byteString prefix)
                  (BSB.byteString separator)
                  (BSB.byteString postfix)


IL(vecToBuilder_) :: (VG.Vector v a)
  => BSB.Builder -- ^ prefix
  -> BSB.Builder -- ^ separator
  -> BSB.Builder -- ^ postfix
  -> (a -> BSB.Builder) -- ^ show function
  -> v a -> BSB.Builder
vecToBuilder_ !prefix !separator !postfix showFct = \vec -> prefix <>
  VG.foldr
  (\ a rest !prefx -> prefx <> (showFct a <> rest separator))
  (const postfix) vec mempty

{-# INLINE_FUSED streamMapFoldl #-}

  where

main :: IO ()
main = do
  [r1,c1,r2,c2] <- map readInt . words <$> getLine
  let requiredCoeffs = (`VU.map` VU.enumFromN (r1+c1) (r2+c2-r1-c1+1))
        $ \ !n -> (n,max r1 $ n-c2, min r2 $ n-c1)
      ress = (\f -> VU.scanl' f (comb (r1+c1) r1) $ vZipTail requiredCoeffs)
             $ \ !prevSum ((!n,!k0n,!k1n),(!np1,!k0np1,!k1np1)) ->
                 prevSum + prevSum
                 + (if k1n < k1np1
                    then comb n k1np1
                    else negate $ comb n k1np1)
                 + (if k0n < k0np1
                     then negate $ comb n k0n
                     else comb n (k0n-1))
  print $ VU.sum ress
  return ()

{-# INLINE_FUSED zipTailWithM_stream #-}
zipTailWithM_stream :: Monad m =>
  (a -> a -> m b) -> VFSM.Stream m a -> VFSM.Stream m b
zipTailWithM_stream f (VFSM.Stream step s) = VFSM.Stream step2 (Nothing, s)
  where
    {-# INLINE_INNER step2 #-}
    step2 (Nothing, s0) = (<$> step s0) $ \res -> case res of
      VFSM.Yield a1 s1 -> VFSM.Skip (Just a1, s1)
      VFSM.Skip     s1 -> VFSM.Skip (Nothing, s1)
      VFSM.Done        -> VFSM.Done
    step2 (Just a0, s0) = step s0 >>= \res -> case res of
      VFSM.Yield a1 s1 -> (`VFSM.Yield` (Just a1, s1)) <$> f a0 a1
      VFSM.Skip     s1 -> return $ VFSM.Skip (Just a0, s1)
      VFSM.Done        -> return $ VFSM.Done

{-# INLINE zipTailWith_stream #-}
zipTailWith_stream :: Monad m =>
  (a -> a -> b) -> VFSM.Stream m a -> VFSM.Stream m b
zipTailWith_stream f = zipTailWithM_stream (\a0 a1 -> return (f a0 a1))

{-# INLINE zipTail_stream #-}
zipTail_stream :: Monad m => VFSM.Stream m a -> VFSM.Stream m (a,a)
zipTail_stream = zipTailWith_stream (,)

{-# INLINE_FUSED zipTailWithM_mbundle #-}

  (a -> a -> m b) -> VFBM.Bundle m v a -> VFBM.Bundle m v b
zipTailWithM_mbundle f VFBM.Bundle{VFBM.sElems = s, VFBM.sSize = n}
  = VFBM.fromStream (zipTailWithM_stream f s) (VFBS.clampedSubtract n 1)

zipTailWith_mbundle :: Monad m =>
  (a -> a -> b) -> VFBM.Bundle m v a -> VFBM.Bundle m v b
zipTailWith_mbundle f = zipTailWithM_mbundle (\a0 a1 -> return $ f a0 a1)

factMax :: Int
factMax = 10^6 + 30

factorials :: VU.Vector RemF
factorials
  = VU.scanl' (*) 1 $ VU.tail $ VU.generate (factMax+1) (remF . fromIntegral)

factorial :: Int -> RemF
factorial = (factorials VU.!)

factoInvs :: VU.Vector RemF
factoInvs
  = VU.reverse
  $ VU.scanl' (*) (recip $ VU.last factorials)
  $ VU.enumFromStepN (fromIntegral factMax) (fromIntegral (-1)) factMax 

invFacto :: Int -> RemF
invFacto = (factoInvs VU.!)

perm :: Int -> Int -> RemF
perm !n !k
  | k == 0 = 1
  | k < 0 || k > n || n < 0 = 0
  | otherwise = factorial n * invFacto (n-k)

comb :: Int -> Int -> RemF
comb !n !k
  | k == 0 = 1
  | k < 0 || k > n || n < 0 = 0
  | otherwise = factorial n * invFacto k * invFacto (n-k)

{-# INLINE reifyWord32 #-}
reifyWord32 :: forall a. Word32 ->
  (forall (m :: *). HasWord32 m => Proxy m -> a) -> a
reifyWord32 v f = unsafeCoerce (Magic f :: Magic a) (const v) Proxy

newtype Rem m = Rem {unRem :: Word32} deriving (Eq)

withTypeArgOf :: c a -> d a -> c a
{-# INLINE CONLIKE withTypeArgOf #-}
withTypeArgOf = const

proxyFor :: c a -> Proxy a
{-# INLINE CONLIKE proxyFor #-}
proxyFor = const Proxy

withProxy :: (Proxy m -> c m) -> c m
{-# INLINE withProxy #-}
withProxy f = f Proxy

remP :: Proxy m -> Word32 -> Rem m
{-# INLINE CONLIKE remP #-}
remP = const Rem

{-# INLINE modulus32 #-}
modulus32 :: HasWord32 m => Rem m -> Word32
modulus32 x = word32Val $ proxyFor x

class HasWord32 m where
  word32Val :: Proxy m -> Word32

instance Show (Rem m) where
  {-# INLINE showsPrec #-}
  showsPrec = coerce `asTypeOf` (\f p (Rem v) -> f p v) $ showsPrec

negRem :: HasWord32 m => Rem m -> Rem m
{-# INLINE negRem #-}
negRem x0@(Rem x)
  | x == 0 = Rem 0
  | otherwise = Rem $ modulus32 x0 - x

addRem, subRem, multRem
  :: HasWord32 m => Rem m -> Rem m -> Rem m
{-# INLINE subRem #-}
subRem x0@(Rem x) (Rem y) = Rem $ x-y + if x < y then modulus32 x0 else 0
{-# INLINE addRem #-}
addRem x0@(Rem x) (Rem y) = Rem $ x-negy + if x < negy then m else 0
  where m = modulus32 x0; negy = m-y
{-# INLINE multRem #-}
multRem x0@(Rem x) (Rem y)
  = Rem $ toW32 $ (toW64 x * toW64 y) `rem` toW64 (modulus32 x0)

{-# INLINE fromIntegerRem #-}
fromIntegerRem :: (HasWord32 m) => Integer -> Rem m
fromIntegerRem x = withProxy $ Rem . fromInteger . mod x . toInteger . word32Val

{-# INLINE signumRem #-}
signumRem :: (HasWord32 m) => Rem m -> Rem m
signumRem = (\case True -> Rem 0; False -> Rem 1) . (== Rem 0)

instance HasWord32 m => Num (Rem m) where
  {-# INLINE negate #-}
  negate = negRem
  {-# INLINE (-) #-}
  (-) = subRem
  {-# INLINE (+) #-}
  (+) = addRem
  {-# INLINE (*) #-}
  (*) = multRem
  {-# INLINE fromInteger #-}
  fromInteger = fromIntegerRem
  {-# INLINE abs #-}
  abs = id
  {-# INLINE signum #-}
  signum = signumRem

recipRem :: HasWord32 m => Rem m -> Rem m
{-# INLINE recipRem #-}
recipRem = \x -> x ^ (modulus32 x - 2)

-- works only for primes
instance HasWord32 m => Fractional (Rem m) where
  {-# INLINE recip #-}
  recip = recipRem
  fromRational q = fromInteger (numerator q) / fromInteger (denominator q)

IL(showTupAsBuilderWith)
  :: (a -> BSB.Builder) -> (b -> BSB.Builder) -> (a,b) -> BSB.Builder
showTupAsBuilderWith showA showB
  = \(a,b) -> (showA a <>) $ BSB.char7 ' ' <> showB b
IL(showTupAsBuilder) :: (ShowAsBuilder a, ShowAsBuilder b)
  => (a,b) -> BSB.Builder
showTupAsBuilder = showTupAsBuilderWith showAsBuilder showAsBuilder 

IL(showTup3AsBuilderWith) :: (a -> BSB.Builder) -> (b -> BSB.Builder) ->
  (c -> BSB.Builder) -> (a,b,c) -> BSB.Builder
showTup3AsBuilderWith showA showB showC
  = \(a,b,c) -> (showA a <>) $ (BSB.char7 ' ' <>) $ (showB b <>)
                $ (BSB.char7 ' ' <>) $ showC c
IL(showTup3AsBuilder) :: (ShowAsBuilder a, ShowAsBuilder b, ShowAsBuilder c)
  => (a,b,c) -> BSB.Builder
showTup3AsBuilder
  = showTup3AsBuilderWith showAsBuilder showAsBuilder showAsBuilder

IL(showTup4AsBuilderWith) :: (a -> BSB.Builder) -> (b -> BSB.Builder) ->
  (c -> BSB.Builder) -> (d -> BSB.Builder) -> (a,b,c,d) -> BSB.Builder
showTup4AsBuilderWith showA showB showC showD
  = \(a,b,c,d) -> (showA a <>) $ (BSB.char7 ' ' <>)
                  $ showTup3AsBuilderWith showB showC showD (b,c,d)
IL(showTup4AsBuilder) ::
  (ShowAsBuilder a, ShowAsBuilder b, ShowAsBuilder c, ShowAsBuilder d) =>
  (a,b,c,d) -> BSB.Builder
showTup4AsBuilder = showTup4AsBuilderWith showAsBuilder showAsBuilder
                    showAsBuilder showAsBuilder

IL(vecToBuilder) :: (VG.Vector v a)
  => BS.ByteString -- ^ prefix
  -> BS.ByteString -- ^ separator
  -> BS.ByteString -- ^ postfix
  -> (a -> BSB.Builder) -- ^ show function
  -> v a -> BSB.Builder
vecToBuilder !prefix !separator !postfix
  = vecToBuilder_ (BSB.byteString prefix)
                  (BSB.byteString separator)
                  (BSB.byteString postfix)


IL(vecToBuilder_) :: (VG.Vector v a)
  => BSB.Builder -- ^ prefix
  -> BSB.Builder -- ^ separator
  -> BSB.Builder -- ^ postfix
  -> (a -> BSB.Builder) -- ^ show function
  -> v a -> BSB.Builder
vecToBuilder_ !prefix !separator !postfix showFct = \vec -> prefix <>
  VG.foldr
  (\ a rest !prefx -> prefx <> (showFct a <> rest separator))
  (const postfix) vec mempty

streamMapFoldl :: (Functor m) =>
  (a -> b -> (c,a)) -> a -> VFSM.Stream m b -> VFSM.Stream m c
{-# INLINE_FUSED streamMapFoldl #-}
streamMapFoldl f a (VFSM.Stream step s) = VFSM.Stream step1 (a,s)
  where
    {-# INLINE_INNER step1 #-}
    step1 (a0,s0) =  (<$> step s0) $ \r -> case r of
      VFSM.Yield b s1 -> case f a0 b of (c,a1) -> VFSM.Yield c (a1,s1)
      VFSM.Skip    s1 -> VFSM.Skip (a0,s1)
      VFSM.Done       -> VFSM.Done

	u = 0

		u = x-q*u
		x = tmp
		tmp = b
		b = a-q*b
		a = tmp
	end

const F=zeros(Int,LIM)
const I=zeros(Int,LIM)
function power(a,b)
	b==0 ? 1 : power(a*a%mod,div(b,2))*(b%2==1 ? a : 1)%mod

function init()
	F[1]=1
	for i=1:LIM-1
		F[i+1]=F[i]*i%mod
	end
	I[LIM]=power(F[LIM],mod-2)
	for i=LIM-1:-1:1
		I[i]=I[i+1]*i%mod
	end
end
function f(R,C)
	ret=0
	for c=0:C
		ret+=F[c+R+2]*I[c+2]%mod*I[R+1]%mod
		ret%=mod
	end
	ret
end

def extended_gcd(a, b)
  last_remainder, remainder = a.abs, b.abs
  x, last_x, y, last_y = 0, 1, 1, 0
  while remainder != 0
    last_remainder, (quotient, remainder) = remainder, last_remainder.divmod(remainder)
    x, last_x = last_x - quotient*x, x
    y, last_y = last_y - quotient*y, y
  end
  return last_remainder, last_x * (a < 0 ? -1 : 1)
end

def mod_power(n, p, m)
  #フェルマーの小定理
  return 1 if p == 0
  if p % 2 == 0
    t = mod_power(n, p / 2, m)
    return t * t % m

  @finv = []

  2.upto(MAX) do |i|
    @fac[i] = @fac[i-1] * i % MOD

  @finv[MAX] = mod_power(@fac[MAX], MOD - 2, MOD)
  (MAX-1).downto(2) do |i|
    @finv[i] = @finv[i+1] * (i + 1) % MOD
  end

def extended_gcd(a, b)
  last_remainder, remainder = a.abs, b.abs
  x, last_x, y, last_y = 0, 1, 1, 0
  while remainder != 0
    last_remainder, (quotient, remainder) = remainder, last_remainder.divmod(remainder)
    x, last_x = last_x - quotient*x, x
    y, last_y = last_y - quotient*y, y
  end
  return last_remainder, last_x * (a < 0 ? -1 : 1)
end

function nCr($n, $r)
{
    if ($r > $n) {
        return NaN;
    }
    if ($n - $r < $r) {
        return nCr($n, $n - $r);
    }
    $return = 1;
    for ($i = 0; $i < $r; $i++) {
        $return *= ($n - $i) / ($i + 1);

import strutils, sequtils, future

const mo: int64 = 1000000000 + 7
type mint = distinct int64
proc toMint[Int](a: Int): mint =
  var res = a.int64 mod mo
  if res < 0:
    res = res + mo
  return res.mint
# うーーーん...
proc `+`[IntA, IntB](a: IntA, b: IntB): mint = (a.int64 + b.int64).toMint
proc `-`[IntA, IntB](a: IntA, b: IntB): mint = (a.int64 - b.int64).toMint
proc `*`[IntA, IntB](a: IntA, b: IntB): mint = (a.int64 * b.int64).toMint
proc pow[Int](a: Int, x: int64): mint =
  assert(x >= 0)
  var
    res = 1.toMint
    base = a
    exp = x
  while exp > 0:
    if (exp and 1) == 1:
      res = res * base
    base = base * base
    exp = exp div 2
  return res
proc inv[Int](a: Int): mint = pow(a, mo - 2)
proc `div`[IntA, IntB](a: IntA, b: IntB): mint = a * inv(b)
proc `$`(a: mint): string {.borrow.}

type C = tuple[fac, inv: seq[mint], binom: (int, int) -> mint]
proc initCombination(n: int = 20): C=
  var
    fac = newSeq[mint](n)
    inv = newSeq[mint](n)
  fac[0] = 1.toMint
  for i in 1..<n:
    fac[i] = i * fac[i - 1]
  inv[n - 1] = 1 div fac[n - 1]
  for i in countdown(n - 2, 0):
    inv[i] = inv[i + 1] * (i + 1)
  proc binom(a, b: int): mint =
    if a < 0 or b < 0: return 0.toMint
    if a < b: return 0.toMint
    return fac[a] * inv[a - b] * inv[b]
  return (fac: fac, inv: inv, binom: binom)

# sum_{i = 0, 1, ..., r} sum_{j = 0, 1, ..., c} f(i, j)
proc solve(r, c: int): mint =
  let n = r + c + 2
  let C = initCombination(n)
  proc countPath(a, b: int): mint =
    return C.binom(a + b, b)
  var res = 0.toMint
  for i in 0..r:
    res = res + countPath(i + 1, c)
  return res

proc main() =
  var r1, c1, r2, c2: int
  (r1, c1, r2, c2) = stdin.readLine.strip.split.map(parseInt)

  var ans = solve(r2, c2)
  ans = ans - solve(r1 - 1, c2)
  ans = ans - solve(r2, c1 - 1)
  ans = ans + solve(r1 - 1, c1 - 1)
  echo ans
main()

proc parseT(s: string; T: typedesc): auto =
  ## `parse` 系関数のジェネリック版
  ## `T` が `SomeOrdinal | SomeFloat` (subranges を含む) でない場合，そのまま `s` を返す
  runnableExamples:
    doAssert parseT("12", int) == 12
    doAssert parseT("12", uint) == 12
    doAssert parseT("12", int64) == 12
    doAssert parseT("12", float32) == 12.0
    doAssert parseT("Yes", bool) == true

  when T is SomeSignedInt: cast[T](parseBiggestInt(s))
  elif T is SomeUnsignedInt: cast[T](parseBiggestUInt(s))
  elif T is SomeFloat: cast[T](parseFloat(s))
  elif T is enum: parseEnum[T](s)
  elif T is bool: parseBool(s)
  elif T is char: s[0]
  else: s

proc unpackWithParse*(input: openArray[string]; T: typedesc[tuple]): T =
  ## 文字列配列を `T` で指定された `tuple` に `parse` しながら変換する

    doAssert int8 is t.a.type and t.a == 1
    doAssert uint32 is t.b.type and t.b == 1
    doAssert float64 is t.c.type and t.c == 1.0
    doAssert bool is t.d.type and t.d == true
    doAssert tuple[a: int8, b: uint32, c: float64, d: bool] is t.type

  var i = 0
  for x in result.fields:
    if i > input.high:
      warn "元の配列の長さが " & $T.arity & " 未満だから，一部デフォルト値になってるよ"
      break
    x = parseT(input[i], x.type)
    i.inc
  result

proc toTupleType(parTuple: NimNode): NimNode {.compileTime.} =
  ## `nnkPar` で表現されてる名前付きタプルを `tuple[]` 形式に変換する
  ## `nnkPar` が名前付きタプルじゃない場合は，そのまま返す
  runnableExamples:
    static:
      doAssert((quote do: (a: int, b: float)).toTupleType == (quote do: tuple[a: int, b: float]))
      doAssert((quote do: (a, b: int)).toTupleType == (quote do: tuple[a, b: int]))
      doAssert((quote do: (int, int)).toTupleType == (quote do: (int, int)))
      doAssert((quote do: ()).toTupleType == (quote do: ()))

  if parTuple.len == 0 or parTuple.findChild(it.kind == nnkExprColonExpr) == nil: # () or (T, U, ...)
    result = parTuple
  else:
    result = newTree(nnkTupleTy)
    var identDefs = newTree(nnkIdentDefs)
    for field in parTuple:
      if field.kind == nnkIdent: # (a, b, ..., x: T)  の a, b, ... 部分 (x 以外)
        identDefs.add(field)
      field.copyChildrenTo(identDefs)
      if field.kind != nnkIdent: # (..., x: T, y: ...) の x: T 部分
        identDefs.add(newEmptyNode())
        result.add(identDefs)
        identDefs = newTree(nnkIdentDefs)

proc seqInputCall(bracketTree: NimNode): NimNode {.compileTime.} =
  ## `seq[N, seq[M, ..., [seq[T]]...]]` を `newSeqWith(N, newSeqWith(M, ..., input(seq[T])...))` にする

  if bracketTree.kind != nnkBracketExpr:
    case bracketTree.kind:
      of nnkPar: # x: (Field0: ...)
        result = newCall("input", bracketTree.toTupleType)
      else: # x: T
        result = newCall("input", bracketTree)
  else:
    case bracketTree.len:
      of 2: # seq[N, ... seq[T] ...] の seq[T]
        if bracketTree[^1].kind == nnkBracketExpr:
          error("seq[seq[T]] みたいな書き方はできないって言ったでしょ！ seq[N, seq[T]] みたいに書き直してっ")
        result = newCall("input", bracketTree)
      of 3: # それ以外 (seq[N, ...])
        result = newCall("newSeqWith", bracketTree[1], seqInputCall(bracketTree[^1]))
      else:
        error("変な入力があるよ")

proc appendedProcCallBlocks(procCalls: NimNode; i: int): NimNode =
  ## `procCalls[i]` の関数呼び出しを
  ## .. code-block:: Nim
  ##   block:
  ##     var it = procCall(...)
  ## という形に変換しながらつなげていく
  ## 最後だけは
  ## .. code-block:: Nim
  ##   block:
  ##     var it = lastProcCall(...)
  ##     it
  ## というようにして `it` を返すようにする

  let it = ident("it")
  let procCall = procCalls[i]
  result = newStmtList(quote do:
    var `it` = `procCall`
  )
  if i == procCalls.len - 1: # 最後の要素だけは it を返すようにする
    result.add(it)
  else:
    result.add(appendedProcCallBlocks(procCalls, i + 1))
  result = newBlockStmt(result)

proc inputsImpl(pre, post: NimNode): NimNode {.compileTime.} =
  ## pre で指定された変数に post の結果を入れる

  # input() 部分の生成
  var inputCall: NimNode
  case pre.kind:
    of nnkPar: # (x, y, ...): ...
      result = newTree(nnkVarTuple)
      pre.copyChildrenTo(result)
      result.add(newEmptyNode())
      case post[0].kind:
        of nnkPar: # (x, y, ...): (T, T, ...)
          inputCall = newCall("input", post[0].toTupleType)
        of nnkTupleTy: # (x, y, ...): tuple[Field0: ...]
          inputCall = newCall("input", post)
        else: # (x, y, ...): T
          var parTupleTy = newTree(nnkPar)
          for _ in 0..<pre.len: parTupleTy.add(post[0]) # (int, int, int, ...) みたいなのを作ってる
          inputCall = newCall("input", parTupleTy)
    else: # x: ...
      result = newTree(nnkIdentDefs).add(pre).add(newEmptyNode())
      case post[0].kind:
        of nnkPar: # x: (Field0: ...)
          inputCall = newCall("input", post[0].toTupleType)
        of nnkBracketExpr:
          inputCall = seqInputCall(post[0])
        else: # x: T
          inputCall = newCall("input", post[0])

  # 関数部分の生成（ある場合）と結合
  if post.len > 1:
    let it = ident("it")
    var itStmts = when NimMajor == 0 and NimMinor < 17: newStmtList(quote do: (var `it` = `inputCall`)) # 入力の読み込み
                  else: newStmtList(quote do: (var `it` {.used.} = `inputCall`))
    itStmts.add(appendedProcCallBlocks(post, 1)) # 関数の適用
    result.add(newTree(nnkStmtListExpr, newBlockStmt(itStmts))) # 結合
  else:
    result.add(inputCall) # 結合

macro inputs*(body: untyped): untyped =
  ## 入力を受け取る
  ## 宣言の後に `it` を用いた式を（`y` みたいに用いなくてもいいんだけど）いくつでもかくことができ，
  ## その返り値が変数の値となる
  ## 式中で型が変わってもいい（下の例の `u`, `y` とか見たいな感じ）
  ##
  ## .. code-block:: Nim
  ##   inputs:
  ##     a: int
  ##     b: string
  ##     c: (x: char, y: float)
  ##     d: tuple[x: char, y: float]
  ##     e: (u, v: BiggestInt)
  ##     f: tuple[u, v: int]
  ##     g: seq[int]
  ##     h: seq[a, seq[int]]
  ##     i: seq[a, (s, t: int)]
  ##     (j, k, l): int
  ##     (m, n): (char, float)
  ##     o: seq[a, string]
  ##     (p): int
  ##     q: seq[int]; it.sorted(system.cmp)
  ##     r: seq[float]; it.sorted(cmp).filterIt(it > 0)
  ##     s: seq[char]
  ##     t: seq[2, seq[a, int]]
  ##     u: string; parseInt(it); abs(-it)
  ##     (_, v): (a: char, b: char)
  ##     (w, x): tuple[a, b: char]
  ##     y: int; "hoge"

  expectKind(body, nnkStmtList)
  result = newTree(nnkStmtList)
  var letSection = newTree(nnkLetSection)
  for decl in body:
    case decl[0].kind:
      of nnkIdent: # x: ...
        letSection.add(inputsImpl(decl[0], decl[1]))
      of nnkPar:
        expectMinLen(decl[0], 1)
        if decl[0].len == 1: # (x): ... これは x: ... と同じ扱いにしたい
          letSection.add(inputsImpl(decl[0][0], decl[1]))
        else: # (x, y, ...): ...
          letSection.add(inputsImpl(decl[0], decl[1]))
      else:
        expectKind(decl[0], {nnkIdent, nnkPar})

  result.add(letSection)

# 前処理 O(n + log(p))
# クエリ O(1)
# 1 < k <= n <= size/2 (<= 5*10^6 程度くらいまで?)
# MOD: 素数でないといけない
type ModComb* = ref object of RootObj
  modFacs: seq[int]
  modFacInvs: seq[int]
  MOD: int

proc modPow(n, p, m: int): int =
  if p == 0:
    1
  elif p mod 2 == 0:
    let half = modPow(n, p div 2, m)
    half * half mod m
  else:
    n * modPow(n, p - 1, m) mod m

proc newModComb*(size = 10_000_000; MOD = 1_000_000_007): ModComb =
  result = ModComb(modFacs: newSeq[int](size + 1), modFacInvs: newSeq[int](size + 1), MOD: MOD)
  result.modFacs[0] = 1
  result.modFacInvs[0] = 1

  for i in 1..size:
    result.modFacs[i] = result.modFacs[i - 1] * i mod MOD

  result.modFacInvs[size] = modPow(result.modFacs[size], MOD - 2, MOD)
  for i in countdown(size - 1, 0):
    result.modFacInvs[i] = result.modFacInvs[i + 1] * (i + 1) mod MOD

proc C*(this: ModComb; n, r: int): int =
  if r < 0 or n < r:
    0
  else:
    this.modFacs[n] * (this.modFacInvs[r] * this.modFacInvs[n - r] mod this.MOD) mod this.MOD

proc P*(this: ModComb; n, r: int): int =
  if r < 0 or n < r:
    0
  else:
    this.modFacs[n] * this.modFacInvs[n - r] mod this.MOD

proc H*(this: ModComb; n, r: int): int =
  if r == 0:
    1
  else:
    this.C(n + r - 1, r)

proc appendedProcCallBlocks(procCalls: NimNode; i: int): NimNode =
  ## `procCalls[i]` の関数呼び出しを
  ## .. code-block:: Nim
  ##   block:

  ## という形に変換しながらつなげていく

  ## .. code-block:: Nim
  ##   block:
  ##     var it = lastProcCall(...)
  ##     it
  ## というようにして `it` を返すようにする

  let it = ident("it")
  let procCall = procCalls[i]
  result = newStmtList(quote do:
    var `it` = `procCall`
  )
  if i == procCalls.len - 1: # 最後の要素だけは it を返すようにする
    result.add(it)
  else:
    result.add(appendedProcCallBlocks(procCalls, i + 1))
  result = newBlockStmt(result)

proc inputsImpl(pre, post: NimNode): NimNode {.compileTime.} =
  ## pre で指定された変数に post の結果を入れる

  # input() 部分の生成
  var inputCall: NimNode
  case pre.kind:
    of nnkPar: # (x, y, ...): ...
      result = newTree(nnkVarTuple)
      pre.copyChildrenTo(result)
      result.add(newEmptyNode())
      case post[0].kind:
        of nnkPar: # (x, y, ...): (T, T, ...)
          inputCall = newCall("input", post[0].toTupleType)
        of nnkTupleTy: # (x, y, ...): tuple[Field0: ...]
          inputCall = newCall("input", post)
        else: # (x, y, ...): T
          var parTupleTy = newTree(nnkPar)
          for _ in 0..<pre.len: parTupleTy.add(post[0]) # (int, int, int, ...) みたいなのを作ってる
          inputCall = newCall("input", parTupleTy)
    else: # x: ...
      result = newTree(nnkIdentDefs).add(pre).add(newEmptyNode())
      case post[0].kind:
        of nnkPar: # x: (Field0: ...)
          inputCall = newCall("input", post[0].toTupleType)
        of nnkBracketExpr:
          inputCall = seqInputCall(post[0])
        else: # x: T
          inputCall = newCall("input", post[0])

  # 関数部分の生成（ある場合）と結合
  if post.len > 1:
    let it = ident("it")
    var itStmts = when NimMajor == 0 and NimMinor < 17: newStmtList(quote do: (var `it` = `inputCall`)) # 入力の読み込み
                  else: newStmtList(quote do: (var `it` {.used.} = `inputCall`))
    itStmts.add(appendedProcCallBlocks(post, 1)) # 関数の適用
    result.add(newTree(nnkStmtListExpr, newBlockStmt(itStmts))) # 結合
  else:
    result.add(inputCall) # 結合

macro inputs*(body: untyped): untyped =
  ## 入力を受け取る
  ## 宣言の後に `it` を用いた式を（`y` みたいに用いなくてもいいんだけど）いくつでもかくことができ，
  ## その返り値が変数の値となる
  ## 式中で型が変わってもいい（下の例の `u`, `y` とか見たいな感じ）
  ##
  ## .. code-block:: Nim
  ##   inputs:
  ##     a: int
  ##     b: string
  ##     c: (x: char, y: float)
  ##     d: tuple[x: char, y: float]
  ##     e: (u, v: BiggestInt)
  ##     f: tuple[u, v: int]
  ##     g: seq[int]
  ##     h: seq[a, seq[int]]
  ##     i: seq[a, (s, t: int)]
  ##     (j, k, l): int
  ##     (m, n): (char, float)
  ##     o: seq[a, string]
  ##     (p): int
  ##     q: seq[int]; it.sorted(system.cmp)
  ##     r: seq[float]; it.sorted(cmp).filterIt(it > 0)
  ##     s: seq[char]
  ##     t: seq[2, seq[a, int]]
  ##     u: string; parseInt(it); abs(-it)
  ##     (_, v): (a: char, b: char)
  ##     (w, x): tuple[a, b: char]
  ##     y: int; "hoge"

  expectKind(body, nnkStmtList)
  result = newTree(nnkStmtList)
  var letSection = newTree(nnkLetSection)
  for decl in body:
    case decl[0].kind:
      of nnkIdent: # x: ...
        letSection.add(inputsImpl(decl[0], decl[1]))
      of nnkPar:
        expectMinLen(decl[0], 1)
        if decl[0].len == 1: # (x): ... これは x: ... と同じ扱いにしたい
          letSection.add(inputsImpl(decl[0][0], decl[1]))
        else: # (x, y, ...): ...
          letSection.add(inputsImpl(decl[0], decl[1]))
      else:
        expectKind(decl[0], {nnkIdent, nnkPar})

  result.add(letSection)

# 前処理 O(n + log(p))
# クエリ O(1)
# 1 < k <= n <= size/2 (<= 5*10^6 程度くらいまで?)
# MOD: 素数でないといけない
type ModComb* = ref object of RootObj
  modFacs: seq[int]
  modFacInvs: seq[int]
  MOD: int

proc modPow(n, p, m: int): int =
  if p == 0:
    1
  elif p mod 2 == 0:
    let half = modPow(n, p div 2, m)
    half * half mod m
  else:
    n * modPow(n, p - 1, m) mod m

proc newModComb*(size = 10_000_000; MOD = 1_000_000_007): ModComb =
  result = ModComb(modFacs: newSeq[int](size + 1), modFacInvs: newSeq[int](size + 1), MOD: MOD)
  result.modFacs[0] = 1
  result.modFacInvs[0] = 1

  for i in 1..size:
    result.modFacs[i] = result.modFacs[i - 1] * i mod MOD

  result.modFacInvs[size] = modPow(result.modFacs[size], MOD - 2, MOD)
  for i in countdown(size - 1, 0):
    result.modFacInvs[i] = result.modFacInvs[i + 1] * (i + 1) mod MOD

proc C*(this: ModComb; n, r: int): int =
  if r < 0 or n < r:
    0
  else:
    this.modFacs[n] * (this.modFacInvs[r] * this.modFacInvs[n - r] mod this.MOD) mod this.MOD

proc P*(this: ModComb; n, r: int): int =
  if r < 0 or n < r:
    0
  else:
    this.modFacs[n] * this.modFacInvs[n - r] mod this.MOD

proc H*(this: ModComb; n, r: int): int =
  if r == 0:
    1
  else:
    this.C(n + r - 1, r)

import sequtils

type Combination[T] = object
  sz:int
  fact_a, rfact_a, inv_a:seq[T]

proc resize[T](self: var Combination[T], sz:int) =
  if sz < self.sz: return
  var sz = max(self.sz * 2, sz)
  self.fact_a.setlen(sz + 1)
  self.rfact_a.setlen(sz + 1)
  self.inv_a.setlen(sz + 1)
  for i in self.sz + 1..sz: self.fact_a[i] = self.fact_a[i-1] * i
  self.rfact_a[sz] = getDefault(T).init(1) / self.fact_a[sz]
  for i in countdown(sz - 1, self.sz + 1): self.rfact_a[i] = self.rfact_a[i + 1] * (i + 1)
  for i in self.sz + 1..sz: self.inv_a[i] = self.rfact_a[i] * self.fact_a[i - 1]
  self.sz = sz

proc initCombination[T](sz = 100):Combination[T] = 
  let one = getDefault(T).init(1)
  result = Combination[T](sz:0, fact_a: @[one], rfact_a: @[one], inv_a: @[one])
  result.resize(sz)

proc fact[T](self:var Combination[T], k:int):T =
  self.resize(k)
  return self.fact_a[k]
proc rfact[T](self:var Combination[T], k:int):T =
  self.resize(k)
  self.rfact_a[k]
proc inv[T](self:var Combination[T], k:int):T =
  self.resize(k)
  self.inv_a[k]

proc P[T](self:var Combination[T], n,r:int):T =
  if r < 0 or n < r: return T()
  return self.fact(n) * self.rfact(n - r)

proc C[T](self:var Combination[T], p,q:int):T =
  if q < 0 or p < q: return T()
  return self.fact(p) * self.rfact(q) * self.rfact(p - q)

proc H[T](self:var Combination[T], n,r:int):T =
  if n < 0 or r < 0: return T()
  return if r == 0: T().init(1) else: self.C(n + r - 1, r)

const mo: int64 = 1000000000 + 7
proc mpow(a, x: int64): int64 =
  var
    res:int64 = 1
    b = a
    e = x
  while e > 0:
    if (e and 1) == 1:
      res = res * b mod mo
    b = b * b mod mo
    e = e div 2
  return res

# sum_{i = 0, 1, ..., r} sum_{j = 0, 1, ..., c} f(i, j)
proc solve(r, c: int): int64 =
  let n = r + c + 10
  var
    fac = newSeq[int64](n)
    inv = newSeq[int64](n)
  fac[0] = 1
  for i in 1..<n:
    fac[i] = i * fac[i - 1] mod mo
  inv[n - 1] = mpow(fac[n - 1], mo - 2)
  for i in countdown(n - 2, 0):
    inv[i] = inv[i + 1] * (i + 1) mod mo
  proc binom(a, b: int): int64 =
    if a < 0 or b < 0: return 0
    if a < b: return 0
    return fac[a] * inv[a - b] mod mo * inv[b] mod mo
  proc countPath(a, b: int): int64 =
    return binom(a + b, b)
  var res: int64 = 0
  for i in 0..r:
    res = (res + countPath(i + 1, c)) mod mo
  return res

type mint = distinct int64
proc toMint[Int](a: Int): mint =
  var res = a.int64 mod mo
  if res < 0:
    res = res + mo
  return res.mint
# うーーーん...
proc `+`[IntA, IntB](a: IntA, b: IntB): mint = (a.int64 + b.int64).toMint
proc `-`[IntA, IntB](a: IntA, b: IntB): mint = (a.int64 - b.int64).toMint
proc `*`[IntA, IntB](a: IntA, b: IntB): mint = (a.int64 * b.int64).toMint
proc pow[Int](a: Int, x: int64): mint =
  assert(x >= 0)
  var
    res = 1.toMint
    base = a
    exp = x
  while exp > 0:
    if (exp and 1) == 1:
      res = res * base
    base = base * base
    exp = exp div 2
  return res
proc inv[Int](a: Int): mint = pow(a, mo - 2)
proc `div`[IntA, IntB](a: IntA, b: IntB): mint = a * inv(b)
proc `$`(a: mint): string {.borrow.}

proc initFactorial(n: int = 20): tuple[fac, inv: seq[mint]]=
  var
    fac = newSeq[mint](n)
    inv = newSeq[mint](n)
  fac[0] = 1.toMint
  for i in 1..<n:
    fac[i] = i * fac[i - 1]
  inv[n - 1] = 1 div fac[n - 1]
  for i in countdown(n - 2, 0):
    inv[i] = inv[i + 1] * (i + 1)
  return (fac: fac, inv: inv)

# sum_{i = 0, 1, ..., r} sum_{j = 0, 1, ..., c} f(i, j)
proc solve(r, c: int): mint =
  let n = r + c + 2
  let (fac, inv) = initFactorial(n)
  proc binom(a, b: int): mint =
    if a < 0 or b < 0: return 0.toMint
    if a < b: return 0.toMint
    return fac[a] * inv[a - b] * inv[b]
  proc countPath(a, b: int): mint =
    return binom(a + b, b)
  var res = 0.toMint
  for i in 0..r:
    res = res + countPath(i + 1, c)
  return res

proc main() =
  var r1, c1, r2, c2: int
  (r1, c1, r2, c2) = stdin.readLine.strip.split.map(parseInt)

  var ans = solve(r2, c2)
  ans = ans - solve(r1 - 1, c2)
  ans = ans - solve(r2, c1 - 1)
  ans = ans + solve(r1 - 1, c1 - 1)
  echo ans
main()

const mo: int64 = 1000000000 + 7
proc mpow(a, x: int64): int64 =
  if x == 0: return 1
  if x == 1: return a
  if x mod 2 == 0: return mpow(a * a mod mo, x div 2)
  return a * mpow(a, x - 1) mod mo

# sum_{i = 0, 1, ..., r} sum_{j = 0, 1, ..., c} f(i, j)
proc solve(r, c: int): int64 =
  let n = r + c + 10
  var
    fac = newSeq[int64](n)
    inv = newSeq[int64](n)
  fac[0] = 1
  for i in 1..<n:
    fac[i] = i * fac[i - 1] mod mo
  inv[n - 1] = mpow(fac[n - 1], mo - 2)
  for i in countdown(n - 2, 0):
    inv[i] = inv[i + 1] * (i + 1) mod mo
  proc binom(a, b: int): int64 =
    if a < 0 or b < 0: return 0
    if a < b: return 0
    return fac[a] * inv[a - b] mod mo * inv[b] mod mo
  proc countPath(a, b: int): int64 =
    return binom(a + b, b)
  var res: int64 = 0
  for i in 0..r:
    res = (res + countPath(i + 1, c)) mod mo
  return res

proc main() =
  var r1, c1, r2, c2: int
  (r1, c1, r2, c2) = stdin.readLine.strip.split.map(parseInt)

  var ans = solve(r2, c2)
  ans = (ans - solve(r1 - 1, c2) + mo) mod mo
  ans = (ans - solve(r2, c1 - 1) + mo) mod mo
  ans = (ans + solve(r1 - 1, c1 - 1) + mo) mod mo
  echo ans
main()

proc euc(a, b: int): tuple[x, y, g: int] =
  if b == 0: (x: 1, y: 0, g: a)
  else:
    let (x, y, g) = euc(b, a mod b)
    (x: y, y: x - a div b * y, g: g)

const Mod: int = 1_000_000_007
const LowModularZero: int = low(int) div Mod * Mod
type Fin = distinct int
proc fin(a: int): Fin = 
  if a >= 0: Fin(a mod Mod)
  else: Fin((a - LowModularZero) mod Mod)
template finBinOp(f, cal: untyped) =
  proc f(fa, fb: Fin): Fin =
    let a {.inject.} = int(fa)
    let b {.inject.} = int(fb)
    cal.fin
finBinOp(`+`, a + b)
finBinOp(`-`, a - b)
finBinOp(`*`, a * b)
finBinOp(`/`, a * euc(b, Mod).x)
proc `==`(a, b: Fin): bool {.borrow.}
proc `$`(a: Fin): string {.borrow.}
proc `-`(a: Fin): Fin = fin(-int(a))

type FacTable = object
  fa, fi: seq[Fin]
proc initFacTable(n: int): FacTable =
  var fa = @[1.Fin, 1.Fin]
  for i in 2..n: fa.add(fa[i-1] * i.Fin)
  var fi = newSeq[Fin](n+1)
  fi[n] = 1.Fin / fa[n]
  for i in countdown(n, 1): fi[i-1] = fi[i] * i.Fin
  FacTable(fa: fa, fi: fi)
proc binom(ft: FacTable, n, r: int): Fin =
  if n < r or n < 0 or r < 0: 0.Fin
  else: ft.fa[n] * ft.fi[n - r] * ft.fi[r]

const mo: int64 = 1000000007
proc mpow(a: int64, x: int64): int64 =
  if x == 0: return 1
  elif x == 1: return a
  elif x mod 2 == 1: return a * mpow(a, x - 1) mod mo
  return mpow(a * a mod mo, x div 2)

proc binom(n, k: int): int64 =
  if n < 0 or k < 0: return 0
  if n < k: return 0
  return fact[n] * inv[k] mod mo * inv[n - k] mod mo

proc parseT(s: string; T: typedesc): auto =
  ## `parse` 系関数のジェネリック版
  ## `T` が `SomeOrdinal | SomeFloat` (subranges を含む) でない場合，そのまま `s` を返す
  runnableExamples:
    doAssert parseT("12", int) == 12
    doAssert parseT("12", uint) == 12
    doAssert parseT("12", int64) == 12
    doAssert parseT("12", float32) == 12.0
    doAssert parseT("Yes", bool) == true

  when T is SomeSignedInt: cast[T](parseBiggestInt(s))
  elif T is SomeUnsignedInt: cast[T](parseBiggestUInt(s))
  elif T is SomeFloat: cast[T](parseFloat(s))
  elif T is enum: parseEnum[T](s)
  elif T is bool: parseBool(s)
  elif T is char: s[0]
  else: s

proc unpackWithParse*(input: openArray[string]; T: typedesc[tuple]): T =
  ## 文字列配列を `T` で指定された `tuple` に `parse` しながら変換する
  runnableExamples:
    let t = unpackWithParse(@["1", "1", "1", "1", "1"], 4, tuple[a: int8, b: uint32, c: float64, d: bool])
    doAssert int8 is t.a.type and t.a == 1
    doAssert uint32 is t.b.type and t.b == 1
    doAssert float64 is t.c.type and t.c == 1.0
    doAssert bool is t.d.type and t.d == true
    doAssert tuple[a: int8, b: uint32, c: float64, d: bool] is t.type

  var i = 0
  for x in result.fields:
    if i > input.high:
      warn "元の配列の長さが " & $T.arity & " 未満だから，一部デフォルト値になってるよ"
      break
    x = parseT(input[i], x.type)
    i.inc
  result

proc toTupleType(parTuple: NimNode): NimNode {.compileTime.} =
  ## `nnkPar` で表現されてる名前付きタプルを `tuple[]` 形式に変換する
  ## `nnkPar` が名前付きタプルじゃない場合は，そのまま返す
  runnableExamples:
    static:
      doAssert((quote do: (a: int, b: float)).toTupleType == (quote do: tuple[a: int, b: float]))
      doAssert((quote do: (a, b: int)).toTupleType == (quote do: tuple[a, b: int]))
      doAssert((quote do: (int, int)).toTupleType == (quote do: (int, int)))
      doAssert((quote do: ()).toTupleType == (quote do: ()))

  if parTuple.len == 0 or parTuple.findChild(it.kind == nnkExprColonExpr) == nil: # () or (T, U, ...)
    result = parTuple
  else:
    result = newTree(nnkTupleTy)
    var identDefs = newTree(nnkIdentDefs)
    for field in parTuple:
      if field.kind == nnkIdent: # (a, b, ..., x: T)  の a, b, ... 部分 (x 以外)
        identDefs.add(field)
      field.copyChildrenTo(identDefs)
      if field.kind != nnkIdent: # (..., x: T, y: ...) の x: T 部分
        identDefs.add(newEmptyNode())
        result.add(identDefs)
        identDefs = newTree(nnkIdentDefs)

proc seqInputCall(bracketTree: NimNode): NimNode {.compileTime.} =
  ## `seq[N, seq[M, ..., [seq[T]]...]]` を `newSeqWith(N, newSeqWith(M, ..., input(seq[T])...))` にする

  if bracketTree.kind != nnkBracketExpr:
    case bracketTree.kind:
      of nnkPar: # x: (Field0: ...)
        result = newCall("input", bracketTree.toTupleType)
      else: # x: T
        result = newCall("input", bracketTree)
  else:
    case bracketTree.len:
      of 2: # seq[N, ... seq[T] ...] の seq[T]
        if bracketTree[^1].kind == nnkBracketExpr:
          error("seq[seq[T]] みたいな書き方はできないって言ったでしょ！ seq[N, seq[T]] みたいに書き直してっ")
        result = newCall("input", bracketTree)
      of 3: # それ以外 (seq[N, ...])
        result = newCall("newSeqWith", bracketTree[1], seqInputCall(bracketTree[^1]))
      else:
        error("変な入力があるよ")

proc appendedProcCallBlocks(procCalls: NimNode; i: int): NimNode =
  ## `procCalls[i]` の関数呼び出しを
  ## .. code-block:: Nim
  ##   block:
  ##     var it = procCall(...)
  ## という形に変換しながらつなげていく
  ## 最後だけは
  ## .. code-block:: Nim
  ##   block:
  ##     var it = lastProcCall(...)
  ##     it
  ## というようにして `it` を返すようにする

  let it = ident("it")
  let procCall = procCalls[i]
  result = newStmtList(quote do:
    var `it` = `procCall`
  )
  if i == procCalls.len - 1: # 最後の要素だけは it を返すようにする
    result.add(it)
  else:
    result.add(appendedProcCallBlocks(procCalls, i + 1))
  result = newBlockStmt(result)

proc inputsImpl(pre, post: NimNode): NimNode {.compileTime.} =
  ## pre で指定された変数に post の結果を入れる

  # input() 部分の生成
  var inputCall: NimNode
  case pre.kind:
    of nnkPar: # (x, y, ...): ...
      result = newTree(nnkVarTuple)
      pre.copyChildrenTo(result)
      result.add(newEmptyNode())
      case post[0].kind:
        of nnkPar: # (x, y, ...): (T, T, ...)
          inputCall = newCall("input", post[0].toTupleType)
        of nnkTupleTy: # (x, y, ...): tuple[Field0: ...]
          inputCall = newCall("input", post)
        else: # (x, y, ...): T
          var parTupleTy = newTree(nnkPar)
          for _ in 0..<pre.len: parTupleTy.add(post[0]) # (int, int, int, ...) みたいなのを作ってる
          inputCall = newCall("input", parTupleTy)
    else: # x: ...
      result = newTree(nnkIdentDefs).add(pre).add(newEmptyNode())
      case post[0].kind:
        of nnkPar: # x: (Field0: ...)
          inputCall = newCall("input", post[0].toTupleType)
        of nnkBracketExpr:
          inputCall = seqInputCall(post[0])
        else: # x: T
          inputCall = newCall("input", post[0])

  # 関数部分の生成（ある場合）と結合
  if post.len > 1:
    let it = ident("it")
    var itStmts = when NimMajor == 0 and NimMinor < 17: newStmtList(quote do: (var `it` = `inputCall`)) # 入力の読み込み
                  else: newStmtList(quote do: (var `it` {.used.} = `inputCall`))
    itStmts.add(appendedProcCallBlocks(post, 1)) # 関数の適用
    result.add(newTree(nnkStmtListExpr, newBlockStmt(itStmts))) # 結合
  else:
    result.add(inputCall) # 結合

macro inputs*(body: untyped): untyped =
  ## 入力を受け取る
  ## 宣言の後に `it` を用いた式を（`y` みたいに用いなくてもいいんだけど）いくつでもかくことができ，
  ## その返り値が変数の値となる
  ## 式中で型が変わってもいい（下の例の `u`, `y` とか見たいな感じ）
  ##
  ## .. code-block:: Nim
  ##   inputs:
  ##     a: int
  ##     b: string
  ##     c: (x: char, y: float)
  ##     d: tuple[x: char, y: float]
  ##     e: (u, v: BiggestInt)
  ##     f: tuple[u, v: int]
  ##     g: seq[int]
  ##     h: seq[a, seq[int]]
  ##     i: seq[a, (s, t: int)]
  ##     (j, k, l): int
  ##     (m, n): (char, float)
  ##     o: seq[a, string]
  ##     (p): int
  ##     q: seq[int]; it.sorted(system.cmp)
  ##     r: seq[float]; it.sorted(cmp).filterIt(it > 0)
  ##     s: seq[char]
  ##     t: seq[2, seq[a, int]]
  ##     u: string; parseInt(it); abs(-it)
  ##     (_, v): (a: char, b: char)
  ##     (w, x): tuple[a, b: char]
  ##     y: int; "hoge"

  expectKind(body, nnkStmtList)
  result = newTree(nnkStmtList)
  var letSection = newTree(nnkLetSection)
  for decl in body:
    case decl[0].kind:
      of nnkIdent: # x: ...
        letSection.add(inputsImpl(decl[0], decl[1]))
      of nnkPar:
        expectMinLen(decl[0], 1)
        if decl[0].len == 1: # (x): ... これは x: ... と同じ扱いにしたい
          letSection.add(inputsImpl(decl[0][0], decl[1]))
        else: # (x, y, ...): ...
          letSection.add(inputsImpl(decl[0], decl[1]))
      else:
        expectKind(decl[0], {nnkIdent, nnkPar})

  result.add(letSection)

# 前処理 O(n + log(p))
# クエリ O(1)
# 1 < k <= n <= size/2 (<= 5*10^6 程度くらいまで?)
# MOD: 素数でないといけない
type ModComb* = ref object of RootObj
  modFacs: seq[int]
  modFacInvs: seq[int]
  MOD: int

proc modPow(n, p, m: int): int =
  if p == 0:
    1
  elif p mod 2 == 0:
    let half = modPow(n, p div 2, m)
    half * half mod m
  else:
    n * modPow(n, p - 1, m) mod m

proc newModComb*(size = 10_000_000; MOD = 1_000_000_007): ModComb =
  result = ModComb(modFacs: newSeq[int](size + 1), modFacInvs: newSeq[int](size + 1), MOD: MOD)
  result.modFacs[0] = 1
  result.modFacInvs[0] = 1

  for i in 1..size:
    result.modFacs[i] = result.modFacs[i - 1] * i mod MOD

  result.modFacInvs[size] = modPow(result.modFacs[size], MOD - 2, MOD)
  for i in countdown(size - 1, 0):
    result.modFacInvs[i] = result.modFacInvs[i + 1] * (i + 1) mod MOD

proc C*(this: ModComb; n, r: int): int =
  if r < 0 or n < r:
    0
  else:
    this.modFacs[n] * (this.modFacInvs[r] * this.modFacInvs[n - r] mod this.MOD) mod this.MOD

proc P*(this: ModComb; n, r: int): int =
  if r < 0 or n < r:
    0
  else:
    this.modFacs[n] * this.modFacInvs[n - r] mod this.MOD

proc H*(this: ModComb; n, r: int): int =
  if r == 0:
    1
  else:
    this.C(n + r - 1, r)

const modulus = 10 ^ 9 + 7

type ModInt* = object
  v: int

proc initModInt*(n: int): ModInt =
  result.v = (n mod modulus + modulus) mod modulus

proc `$`*(x: ModInt): string =
  $x.v

proc pow*(x: ModInt, n: int): ModInt =
  if n < 0:
    return pow(x, -n).pow(modulus - 2)
  var p = 1
  var x = x.v
  var n = n
  while n > 0:
    if (n and 1) != 0:
      p = p * x mod modulus
    x = x * x mod modulus
    n = n shr 1

  result.v = p

proc inverse*(x: ModInt): ModInt =
  pow(x, modulus - 2)

proc `+`*(x: ModInt): ModInt =
  result.v = x.v
proc `-`*(x: ModInt): ModInt =
  result.v = modulus - x.v
  if result.v == modulus: result.v = 0

proc `+`*(a: ModInt, b: ModInt): ModInt =
  result.v = a.v + b.v
  if result.v >= modulus: result.v -= modulus
proc `-`*(a: ModInt, b: ModInt): ModInt =
  result.v = a.v - b.v
  if result.v < 0: result.v += modulus
proc `*`*(a: ModInt, b: ModInt): ModInt =
  result.v = a.v * b.v
  if result.v >= modulus: result.v = result.v mod modulus
proc `/`*(a: ModInt, b: ModInt): ModInt =
  result.v = a.v * b.inverse().v
  if result.v >= modulus: result.v = result.v mod modulus

proc `+`*(a: ModInt, b: int): ModInt =
  a + initModInt(b)
proc `-`*(a: ModInt, b: int): ModInt =
  a - initModInt(b)
proc `*`*(a: ModInt, b: int): ModInt =
  a * initModInt(b)
proc `/`*(a: ModInt, b: int): ModInt =
  a / initModInt(b)

proc `+`*(a: int, b: ModInt): ModInt =
  initModInt(a) + b
proc `-`*(a: int, b: ModInt): ModInt =
  initModInt(a) - b

template initFactorial(n: int = 20) =
  var
    fac {.inject} = newSeq[mint](n)
    inv {.inject} = newSeq[mint](n)
  fac[0] = 1.toMint
  for i in 1..<n:
    fac[i] = i * fac[i - 1]
  inv[n - 1] = 1 div fac[n - 1]
  for i in countdown(n - 2, 0):
    inv[i] = inv[i + 1] * (i + 1)

# sum_{i = 0, 1, ..., r} sum_{j = 0, 1, ..., c} f(i, j)
proc solve(r, c: int): mint =
  let n = r + c + 2
  initFactorial(n)
  proc binom(a, b: int): mint =
    if a < 0 or b < 0: return 0.toMint
    if a < b: return 0.toMint
    return fac[a] * inv[a - b] * inv[b]
  proc countPath(a, b: int): mint =
    return binom(a + b, b)
  var res = 0.toMint
  for i in 0..r:
    res = res + countPath(i + 1, c)
  return res

class Combination:
    """
  O(n)の前計算を1回行うことで，O(1)でnCr mod mを求められる
  n_max = 10**6のとき前処理は約950ms (PyPyなら約340ms, 10**7で約1800ms)
  使用例：
  comb = Combination(1000000)
  print(comb(5, 3))  # 10
  """

    def __init__(self, n_max, mod=10 ** 9 + 7):
        self.mod = mod
        self.modinv = self.make_modinv_list(n_max)
        self.fac, self.facinv = self.make_factorial_list(n_max)

    def __call__(self, n, r):
        if n < r or n < 0 or r < 0:
            return 0
        return self.fac[n] * self.facinv[r] % self.mod * self.facinv[n - r] % self.mod

    def make_factorial_list(self, n):
        # 階乗のリストと階乗のmod逆元のリストを返す O(n)
        # self.make_modinv_list()が先に実行されている必要がある
        fac = [1]

        facinv = [1]
        for i in range(1, n + 1):
            fac.append(fac[i - 1] * i % self.mod)
            facinv.append(facinv[i - 1] * self.modinv[i] % self.mod)
        return fac, facinv

    def make_modinv_list(self, n):
        # 0からnまでのmod逆元のリストを返す O(n)
        modinv = [0] * (n + 1)
        modinv[1] = 1
        for i in range(2, n + 1):
            modinv[i] = self.mod - self.mod // i * \
                modinv[self.mod % i] % self.mod
        return modinv

class factorial:
  def __init__(self, n, p=10**9 + 7):
    self.__p  = p
    self.__fac  = [0] * (n+1)
    self.__inv  = [0] * (n+1)
    self.__finv = [0] * (n+1)

    self.__fac[0] = self.__fac[1] = 1
    self.__inv[1] = 1
    self.__finv[0] = self.__finv[1] = 1

    for i in range(2, n+1):
      self.__fac[i] = self.__fac[i-1] * i % p
      self.__inv[i] = p - self.__inv[p%i] * (p // i) % p
      self.__finv[i] = self.__finv[i-1] * self.__inv[i] % p
  
  def fact(self, n):
    return self.__fac[n]
  
  def perm(self, n, k):
    return self.__fac[n] * self.__finv[n-k] % self.__p
  
  def comb(self, n, k):
    return self.perm(n, k) * self.__finv[k] % self.__p

    numer = reduce(mul, range(n, n - r, -1), 1)

def extgcd(a,b):
    r = [1, 0, a]
    w = [0, 1, b]
    while w[2] != 1:
        q = r[2]//w[2]
        ra = w
        wa = [r[0]-q*w[0], r[1]-q*w[1], r[2]-q*w[2]]
        r = ra
        w = wa
    #[x,y]
    return [w[0], w[1]]

def mod_inv(a,m):
    x = extgcd(a, m)[0]
    return (m+x%m)%m

class ModComb:

    def __init__(self, bound, mod):
        self.bound, self.mod = bound, mod
        self.g1, self.g2, self.inv = [1, 1], [1, 1], [0, 1]
        for i in range(2, self.bound + 1):
            self.g1.append(self.g1[-1] * i % self.mod)
            self.inv.append(-self.inv[self.mod % i]
                            * (self.mod // i) % self.mod)
            self.g2.append(self.g2[-1] * self.inv[-1] % self.mod)

    def f(self, r, c):
        if r == 0 or c == 0:
            return 0
        tmp = self.g1[r + c + 2] * self.g2[r + 1] * self.g2[c + 1] % self.mod
        return (tmp - (r + c + 2)) % self.mod

class Factorial:
    def __init__(self,n,mod):
        self.f=f=[0]*(n+1)
        f[0]=b=1
        self.mod=mod
        for i in range(1,n+1):f[i]=b=b*i%mod
        self.inv=inv=[0]*(n+1)
        inv[0]=b=pow(self.f[n],mod-2,mod)
        for i in range(1,n+1):inv[i]=b=b*(n+1-i)%mod
        self.inv.reverse()
    def factorial(self,i):

class Combination:
    """
    O(n)の前計算を1回行うことで，O(1)でnCr mod mを求められる
    n_max = 10**6のとき前処理は約950ms (PyPyなら約340ms, 10**7で約1800ms)
    使用例：
    comb = Combination(1000000)
    print(comb(5, 3))  # 10
    """
    def __init__(self, n_max, mod=10**9+7):
        self.mod = mod
        self.modinv = self.make_modinv_list(n_max)
        self.fac, self.facinv = self.make_factorial_list(n_max)

    def __call__(self, n, r):
        if n < r:
            return 0
        return self.fac[n] * self.facinv[r] % self.mod * self.facinv[n-r] % self.mod

    def make_factorial_list(self, n):
        # 階乗のリストと階乗のmod逆元のリストを返す O(n)
        # self.make_modinv_list()が先に実行されている必要がある
        fac = [1]
        facinv = [1]
        for i in range(1, n+1):
            fac.append(fac[i-1] * i % self.mod)
            facinv.append(facinv[i-1] * self.modinv[i] % self.mod)
        return fac, facinv

    def make_modinv_list(self, n):
        # 0からnまでのmod逆元のリストを返す O(n)
        modinv = [0] * (n+1)
        modinv[1] = 1
        for i in range(2, n+1):
            modinv[i] = self.mod - self.mod//i * modinv[self.mod%i] % self.mod
        return modinv

class factorial:
  def __init__(self, n, p=10**9 + 7):
    self.__p  = p
    self.__fac  = [0] * (n+1)
    self.__inv  = [0] * (n+1)
    self.__finv = [0] * (n+1)

    self.__fac[0] = self.__fac[1] = 1
    self.__inv[1] = 1
    self.__finv[0] = self.__finv[1] = 1

    for i in range(2, n+1):
      self.__fac[i] = self.__fac[i-1] * i % p
      self.__inv[i] = p - self.__inv[p%i] * (p // i) % p
      self.__finv[i] = self.__finv[i-1] * self.__inv[i] % p
  
  def fact(self, n):
    return self.__fac[n]
  
  def perm(self, n, k):
    return self.__fac[n] * self.__finv[n-k] % self.__p
  
  def comb(self, n, k):
    return self.perm(n, k) * self.__finv[k] % self.__p

    ifact[n] = pow(fact[n], MOD-2, MOD)

def cumprod(arr, MOD):
    L = len(arr); Lsq = int(L**.5+1)
    arr = np.resize(arr, Lsq**2).reshape(Lsq, Lsq)
    for n in range(1, Lsq):
        arr[:, n] *= arr[:, n-1]; arr[:, n] %= MOD
    for n in range(1, Lsq):
        arr[n] *= arr[n-1, -1]; arr[n] %= MOD
    return arr.ravel()[:L]

    self.__p  = p
    self.__fac  = [0] * (n+1)
    self.__inv  = [0] * (n+1)
    self.__finv = [0] * (n+1)

    self.__fac[0] = self.__fac[1] = 1
    self.__inv[1] = 1
    self.__finv[0] = self.__finv[1] = 1

    for i in range(2, n+1):
      self.__fac[i] = self.__fac[i-1] * i % p
      self.__inv[i] = p - self.__inv[p%i] * (p // i) % p
      self.__finv[i] = self.__finv[i-1] * self.__inv[i] % p
  
  def fact(self, n):
    return self.__fac[n]
  
  def perm(self, n, k):
    return self.__fac[n] * self.__finv[n-k] % self.__p
  
  def comb(self, n, k):
    return self.perm(n, k) * self.__finv[k] % self.__p

class Factorial():
    def __init__(self,n,mod):
        self.mod = mod
        self.factorial = [0 for _ in range(n+1)]
        self.inv = [0 for _ in range(n+1)]
        self.factorial[0] = 1
        self.inv[0] = 1
        for i in range(n):

        self.inv[n] = pow(self.factorial[n],mod-2,mod)
        for i in range(n)[::-1]:
            self.inv[i] = self.inv[i+1]*(i+1)%mod


    def comb(self,m,k): #組み合わせ 0<=k<=m<=n
        return self.factorial[m]*self.inv[k]*self.inv[m-k]%self.mod

import copy


def prepare(n, MOD):
 
    # 1! - n! の計算
    f = 1
    factorials = [1]  # 0!の分
    for m in range(1, n + 1):
        f *= m
        f %= MOD
        factorials.append(f)
    # n!^-1 の計算
    inv = pow(f, MOD - 2, MOD)
    # n!^-1 - 1!^-1 の計算
    invs = [1] * (n + 1)
    invs[n] = inv
    for m in range(n, 1, -1):
        inv *= m
        inv %= MOD
        invs[m - 1] = inv
     
    return factorials, invs

class Combination:
    """
  O(n)の前計算を1回行うことで，O(1)でnCr mod mを求められる
  n_max = 10**6のとき前処理は約950ms (PyPyなら約340ms, 10**7で約1800ms)
  使用例：
  comb = Combination(1000000)
  print(comb(5, 3))  # 10
  """

    def __init__(self, n_max, mod=10 ** 9 + 7):
        self.mod = mod
        self.modinv = self.make_modinv_list(n_max)
        self.fac, self.facinv = self.make_factorial_list(n_max)

    def __call__(self, n, r):
        if n < r or n < 0 or r < 0:
            return 0
        return self.fac[n] * self.facinv[r] % self.mod * self.facinv[n - r] % self.mod

    def make_factorial_list(self, n):
        # 階乗のリストと階乗のmod逆元のリストを返す O(n)
        # self.make_modinv_list()が先に実行されている必要がある
        fac = [1]

        facinv = [1]
        for i in range(1, n + 1):
            fac.append(fac[i - 1] * i % self.mod)
            facinv.append(facinv[i - 1] * self.modinv[i] % self.mod)
        return fac, facinv

    def make_modinv_list(self, n):
        # 0からnまでのmod逆元のリストを返す O(n)
        modinv = [0] * (n + 1)
        modinv[1] = 1
        for i in range(2, n + 1):
            modinv[i] = self.mod - self.mod // i * \
                modinv[self.mod % i] % self.mod
        return modinv

class Factorial():
    def __init__(self,n,mod):
        self.mod = mod
        self.factorial = [0 for _ in range(n+1)]
        self.inv = [0 for _ in range(n+1)]
        self.factorial[0] = 1
        self.inv[0] = 1
        for i in range(n):
            self.factorial[i+1] = self.factorial[i]*(i+1)%mod
            self.inv[i+1] = self.inv[i]*pow(i+1,mod-2,mod)%mod
    def comb(self,m,k): #組み合わせ 0<=k<=m<=n
        return self.factorial[m]*self.inv[k]*self.inv[m-k]%self.mod
    def fact(self,m): #階乗
        return self.factorial[m]
    def perm(self,m,k): #順列
        if m < k: return 0
        return self.factorial[m]*self.inv[m-k]%self.mod
    def invfact(self,m): #階乗の逆数
        return self.inv[m]

class Combination:
    """
    SIZEが10^6程度以下の二項係数を何回も呼び出したいときに使う
    使い方:
    comb = Combination(SIZE, MOD)
    comb(10, 3) => 120
    """

    def __init__(self, N, MOD=10 ** 9 + 7):
        self.MOD = MOD
        self.fact, self.inv = self._make_factorial_list(N)

    def __call__(self, n, k):
        if k < 0 or k > n:
            return 0
        res = self.fact[n] * self.inv[k] % self.MOD
        res = res * self.inv[n - k] % self.MOD
        return res

    def _make_factorial_list(self, N):
        fact = [1] * (N + 1)
        inv = [1] * (N + 1)
        MOD = self.MOD
        for i in range(1, N + 1):
            fact[i] = (fact[i - 1] * i) % MOD
        inv[N] = pow(fact[N], MOD - 2, MOD)
        for i in range(N, 0, -1):
            inv[i - 1] = (inv[i] * i) % MOD
        return fact, inv

from collections import defaultdict

class ModInt:

    def __init__(self, mod=1000000007, mem_size=3000000):
        self.mod = mod
        self.mem_factorial = [0] * mem_size
        self.mem_size = mem_size
        self.mem_inv = [0] * mem_size
        self.mem_invfactorial = [0] * mem_size
        self.mem_factorial[0] = 1
        self.mem_inv[1] = 1
        self.mem_invfactorial[0] = 1
        for i in range(1, mem_size):
            self.mem_factorial[i] = self.mem_factorial[i-1]*i % mod
            if i > 1:
                self.mem_inv[i] = (-1) * (mod//i) * (self.mem_inv[mod % i]) % mod
            self.mem_invfactorial[i] = self.mem_invfactorial[i-1] * self.mem_inv[i] % mod

    def inverse(self, x):
        if x < self.mem_size:
            return self.mem_inv[x]
        mod = self.mod
        return int(pow(x, mod-2, mod))

    def factorial(self, x):
        return self.mem_factorial[x]

    def invfactorial(self, x):
        return self.mem_invfactorial[x]


    def comb(self, m, n):
        mod = self.mod
        a = self.factorial(m)
        b = self.invfactorial(n)
        c = self.invfactorial(m - n)
        ret = a * b * c % mod
        return ret

def createFacArr(n, mod):
    '''
    二項係数計算用の配列の作成

    Parameters
    n : int

    mod : int
        あまり

    Returns
    fac : list
        階乗のリスト
    finv : list
        modの逆元のリスト
    ivn : list
    '''
    fac = [0] * n
    finv = [0] * n
    inv = [0] * n
    fac[0], fac[1] = 1, 1
    finv[0], finv[1] = 1, 1
    inv[1] = 1
    for i in range(2, n):
        fac[i] = fac[i-1] * i % mod
        inv[i] = mod - inv[mod%i] * (mod // i) % mod
        finv[i] = finv[i-1] * inv[i] % mod
    return fac, finv

mod = （剰余）

(n!)^{-1}の計算は¥Prod_i i^{-1}を計算して求める。
i^{-1} mod pの計算はフェルマーの小定理より、mod pにおいて
0 = p = (p // i) * i + (p % i)
0 = (p // i) + (p % i) * i^{-1}
i^{-1} = -(p // i) * (p % i)^{-1}
"""

max = 10**6
mod = 10**9+7

factinv = [1, 1] # factinv[n] = ((n!)^{-1} mod p)
inv = [0, 1] # inv[n] = (n^{-1} mod p)

for i in range(2, max+1):
    fact.append(fact[-1] * i % mod)
    inv.append(-inv[mod % i] * (mod // i) % mod)
    factinv.append(factinv[-1] * inv[-1] % mod)

def cmb(n, r):
    if r < 0 or r > n:
        return 0
    else:
        r = min(r, n-r)
        return fact[n] * factinv[r] * factinv[n-r] % mod

def createFacArr(n, mod):
    '''
    二項係数計算用の配列の作成

    Parameters
    n : int
        配列のサイズ
    mod : int
        あまり

    Returns
    fac : list
        階乗のリスト
    finv : list
        modの逆元のリスト
    ivn : list
    '''
    fac = [0] * n
    finv = [0] * n
    inv = [0] * n
    fac[0], fac[1] = 1, 1
    finv[0], finv[1] = 1, 1
    inv[1] = 1
    for i in range(2, n):
        fac[i] = fac[i-1] * i % mod
        inv[i] = mod - inv[mod%i] * (mod // i) % mod
        finv[i] = finv[i-1] * inv[i] % mod
    return fac, finv
